detail.abstract:
Principles of Management – II is a comprehensive textbook designed for FYBCOM (Management Studies) students under the NEP 2020 curriculum of Mumbai University. Authored by Dr. Rashmi, the book bridges classical theories with contemporary practices, presenting management not only as a set of functions but as a dynamic process essential for organizational success.

The book systematically explores the advanced functions of management—Planning, Organizing, Directing, Staffing, Coordinating, Reporting, and Budgeting (PODSCORB)—with practical examples, modern techniques, and relatable case studies. It emphasizes core areas like delegation of authority, leadership, motivation, coordination, and control, equipping students with both conceptual clarity and applied knowledge.

In addition, the book addresses emerging managerial challenges such as change management, time management, and the relevance of tools like Murphy’s Law in decision-making. Real-world insights are provided through case studies of eminent Indian business leaders like Ratan Tata, Narayana Murthy, and Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw, highlighting how vision, ethics, and innovation shape effective management practices.

Structured in simple, student-friendly language, enriched with diagrams and examples, Principles of Management – II offers a balanced blend of theory and practice, making it an essential academic resource and a practical guide for future managers.

AI.tldr: 这是一本为孟买大学NEP 2020课程FYBCOM（管理研究）学生编写的管理教材，将古典理论与当代实践相结合，系统探讨了PODSCORB管理职能，并通过案例研究和实际应用帮助学生理解管理概念。
AI.research_question: 如何将古典管理理论与现代管理实践有效结合，为管理专业学生提供全面的管理知识体系？
AI.motivation: 满足NEP 2020新课程体系下管理教育需求，弥合理论与实践的差距，为学生提供既包含经典管理原理又涵盖当代管理挑战的教材。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于PODSCORB管理职能框架（计划、组织、指挥、人员配备、协调、报告、预算），结合古典管理理论和现代管理实践。
AI.method: 采用教材编写方法，通过系统章节组织、实际案例研究、图表说明和学生友好语言来呈现管理概念。
AI.findings: 成功构建了理论与实践相结合的管理知识体系，通过印度商业领袖案例展示了管理原理的实际应用价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 将古典管理理论与现代管理挑战整合，建立了适合印度教育背景的管理知识框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理专业学生提供了可直接应用的管理工具和技能，通过真实案例帮助学生理解管理概念的实际意义。

title: Who Moderates the Social Media Giants? A Call to End Outsourcing
affiliations: New York University (NYU) - New York University

detail.title: Who Moderates the Social Media Giants? A Call to End Outsourcing
detail.abstract:
Content moderation—the process of deciding what stays online and what gets taken down— is an indispensable aspect of the social media industry. Without it, online platforms would be inundated not just by spam, but by personal bullying, neo-Nazi screeds, terrorist beheadings, and child sexual abuse. 


Despite the centrality of content moderation, however, major social media companies have marginalized the people who do this work, outsourcing the vast majority of it to third-party vendors. A close look at this situation reveals three main problems: 


— In some parts of the world distant from Silicon Valley, the marginalization of content moderation has led to social media companies paying inadequate attention to how their platforms have been misused to stoke ethnic and religious violence. This has occurred in places ranging from Myanmar to Ethiopia. Facebook, for example, has expanded into far-flung markets, seeking to boost its user-growth numbers, without having sufficient moderators in place who understand local languages and cultures.


— The peripheral status of moderators undercuts their receiving adequate counseling and medical care for the psychological side effects of repeated exposure to toxic online content. Watching the worst social media has to offer leaves many moderators emotionally debilitated. Too often, they don’t get the support or benefits they need and deserve. 


— The frequently chaotic outsourced environments in which moderators work impinge on their decisionmaking. Disputes with quality-control reviewers consume time and attention and contribute to a rancorous atmosphere. Outsourcing has become a common aspect of the globalized economy. Examples include customer-help centers in the Philippines, digital device factories in China, and clothing-production facilities in Bangladesh. 


Outsourcing is not inherently detrimental—if workers are paid fairly and treated humanely. A central question raised by outsourcing, in whatever industry it occurs, is whether it leads to worker exploitation. In social media, there’s an additional concern about whether outsourcing jeopardizes optimal performance of a critical function.

AI.tldr: 该论文分析了社交媒体内容审核外包的三大问题：在偏远地区缺乏本地化审核导致平台被滥用煽动暴力；审核员心理健康支持不足；外包环境混乱影响决策质量。
AI.research_question: 社交媒体内容审核外包如何影响审核工作的质量和审核员的福祉？
AI.motivation: 内容审核对社交媒体平台至关重要，但主要公司将其外包给第三方，导致审核员被边缘化，引发了一系列问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于外包理论、劳动力边缘化和平台治理理论，分析内容审核外包的影响。
AI.method: 通过案例分析和问题识别，考察社交媒体内容审核外包的现状和后果。
AI.findings: 发现三个主要问题：1）在偏远地区缺乏本地化审核导致平台被滥用；2）审核员心理健康支持不足；3）外包环境混乱影响决策质量。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了外包理论在数字平台治理中的应用，揭示了内容审核外包对平台安全和员工福祉的双重影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为社交媒体公司改进内容审核实践提供建议，强调需要平衡外包效率和审核质量，保障审核员权益。

title: Equity at a Crossroads: Rethinking Private Provision in Ghana's Higher Education

detail.title: Equity at a Crossroads: Rethinking Private Provision in Ghana's Higher Education

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethical clearance was obtained prior to the commencement of the study. All participants provided informed consent before participating in semi-structured interviews or completing questionnaires. Institutional identities were anonymised to maintain confidentiality, and descriptors were used in place of actual names to protect participants while preserving contextual integrity. Data collection and storage were conducted in compliance with ethical research practices and confidentiality safeguards.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. It was undertaken as part of the author’s independent academic research agenda.

detail.abstract: The interplay between private provision and equitable access to higher education in Ghana presents a critical paradox: while private institutions are poised to expand educational opportunities and ease pressure on overstretched public universities, their declining enrolment and systemic marginalisation reinforce existing socioeconomic disparities. This paper explores the structural barriers impeding the growth and contribution of Private Higher Education Institutions (PHEIs) to Ghana's national development agenda. Using a qualitative design supported by descriptive statistics and thematic analysis, the study draws on literature, regulatory reviews, institutional documents, and key informant interviews with senior administrators of Ghanaian private universities and primarily from lived experiences of Accra Metropolitan University. The findings reveal that charter delays, rigid affiliation requirements, funding constraints, and policy-induced distortions such as the public perception surrounding the recently announced Free First Year Tuition policy are significantly crowding out private providers. Although the policy has not yet been implemented, widespread state messaging has already begun shifting enrolment preferences and reinforcing affordability narratives favouring public institutions. Ghana's tertiary Gross Enrolment Ratio (GER) stood at 21.99 percent in 2023, well below the global average of 40.35 percent. Public universities absorbed 89 percent of enrolments, while the share for private universities dropped to 11 percent, down from 20 percent in 2012. This trend raises critical questions about sustainability, inclusivity, and the strategic role of private providers, especially in reaching underserved and non-traditional learners. Through the lenses of public good theory and coercive isomorphism, the paper argues that Ghana must reframe private provision not as a secondary commercial tier but as a strategic pillar for achieving national equity and inclusion. It recommends differentiated accreditation standards, expanded access to funding, strengthened public-private partnerships, and a transition to outcome-based quality assurance. Without targeted structural reforms, private universities will remain institutionally disadvantaged and Ghana's broader goals for inclusive higher education will remain unrealised.

AI.tldr: 加纳私立高等教育机构面临结构性障碍，包括特许延迟、严格附属要求、资金限制和政策扭曲，导致其入学率从2012年的20%降至2023年的11%。研究主张将私立教育重新定位为实现国家公平和包容的战略支柱，并提出差异化认证标准、扩大资金获取、加强公私伙伴关系等改革建议。
AI.research_question: 阻碍加纳私立高等教育机构发展和贡献于国家发展议程的结构性障碍是什么？
AI.motivation: 私立高等教育机构在扩大教育机会和缓解公立大学压力的同时，其入学率下降和系统性边缘化加剧了现有的社会经济差距，这构成了一个关键悖论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公共物品理论和强制性同构理论
AI.method: 定性研究设计，辅以描述性统计和主题分析，包括文献回顾、监管审查、机构文件和与私立大学高级管理人员的深度访谈。
AI.findings: 特许延迟、严格附属要求、资金限制以及政策诱导的扭曲（如免费一年级学费政策的公众认知）显著排挤了私立提供者；尽管政策尚未实施，但国家宣传已开始改变入学偏好，强化了有利于公立机构的可负担性叙事。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过公共物品理论和强制性同构理论框架，论证了私立教育应被重新定义为实现国家公平和包容的战略支柱，而非次要商业层级。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出差异化认证标准、扩大资金获取、加强公私伙伴关系以及向基于结果的质量保证过渡等具体政策建议，以促进私立高等教育的可持续发展。

title: Interview Rounds and Inequality: A Probabilistic Model of Bias Amplification in Sequential Hiring
affiliations: SBS Swiss Business School, Swiss Business School (SBS) and Swiss Business School (SBS) - Department of Management

detail.title: Interview Rounds and Inequality: A Probabilistic Model of Bias Amplification in Sequential Hiring
detail.abstract: Multi-stage interviews are intended to improve hiring accuracy but can unintentionally amplify inequality. We propose the Probabilistic Bias Amplification Model (PBAM), which treats each interview round as shaped by two forces: a neutral (performance-based chance of advancing) and a systematic tilt (bias multiplier) that helps or harms particular groups. Across several rounds, even small tilts at each stage accumulate into significant gaps in who ultimately gets hired-gaps that can remain hidden when stages are assessed in isolation. PBAM integrates insights from signaling theory, procedural justice, and cumulative disadvantage, extending research on structured versus unstructured interviews and pipeline-aware fairness. We offer testable propositions that can be evaluated with Applicant Tracking System data and standard statistical audits of stage-by-stage "survival" rates. Practically, we recommend streamlining excessive rounds, structuring high-discretion stages, and auditing for both penalties (systematic headwinds) and favoritism (systematic tailwinds). By shifting fairness from perception to measurable progression, PBAM provides an actionable basis for diagnosing and reducing bias in human-and AI-mediated recruitment.

AI.tldr: 多轮面试旨在提高招聘准确性，但可能无意中放大不平等。本文提出概率偏差放大模型(PBAM)，将每轮面试视为两种力量塑造：中性（基于表现的晋级机会）和系统性倾斜（偏差乘数）。即使每轮的小倾斜在多轮后也会累积成显著的招聘差距。
AI.research_question: 多轮面试如何无意中放大招聘过程中的不平等？
AI.motivation: 多轮面试旨在提高招聘准确性，但可能无意中放大不平等，这种累积效应在单独评估各阶段时可能被隐藏。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信号理论、程序正义、累积劣势理论，扩展了结构化与非结构化面试研究以及管道意识公平性研究。
AI.method: 使用申请人追踪系统数据和标准统计审计来评估逐阶段"存活率"，提供可检验的命题。
AI.findings: 即使每轮面试中的小倾斜在多轮后也会累积成显著的招聘差距，这些差距在单独评估各阶段时可能被隐藏。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出概率偏差放大模型(PBAM)，整合信号理论、程序正义和累积劣势理论，为诊断和减少招聘偏见提供理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议简化过多轮次、结构化高自由裁量权阶段、审计系统性阻碍和偏袒，将公平性从感知转向可测量的进展。

title: A Dynamic Model of Authority in Organizations
affiliations: and Bielefeld University - Center for Mathematical Economics

detail.title: A Dynamic Model of Authority in Organizations

declarations.funderStatement: the Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft (DFG) through the Research Project Training Group (RTG 2865)—Coping with Uncertainty in Dynamic Economics (CUDE)

detail.abstract: In our principal-agent model, the principal can repeatedly delegate authority to an agent with uncertain preferences or take the decisions himself. The principal learns the state at the end of each period and then updates his belief about the agent's bias based on the decision implemented if he delegated authority. We demonstrate that equilibria are characterized by an "imitation" interval of agent types (biases) who mimic less biased types in order to be retained. Interestingly, the principal generally benefits from the agent's imitation compared to a benchmark. Furthermore, comparative statics reveal that, surprisingly, the principal may be worse off with better information. Finally, an extension to finitely many periods shows that the imitation interval gradually shifts, such that agent types within the interval imitate less biased types.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了一个委托-代理模型，其中委托人可以重复授权给偏好不确定的代理人或自行决策。委托人通过观察代理人决策来更新对其偏见的信念。研究发现均衡中存在代理人模仿区间，代理人会模仿偏见较小的类型以保持授权。有趣的是，委托人通常从代理人模仿中获益，且更好的信息可能反而对委托人不利。
AI.research_question: 在重复授权决策中，委托人如何通过观察代理人决策来学习代理人偏好，以及代理人如何通过策略性模仿来影响授权决策？
AI.motivation: 理解在动态委托-代理关系中，信息不对称和学习过程如何影响授权决策和代理人行为，特别是在代理人偏好不确定的情况下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于委托-代理理论，构建重复授权决策模型，结合贝叶斯学习和博弈论框架分析代理人策略性模仿行为。
AI.method: 构建理论模型，使用博弈论分析方法推导均衡条件，进行比较静态分析，并扩展到有限期情形。
AI.findings: 1. 均衡中存在代理人模仿区间；2. 委托人通常从代理人模仿中获益；3. 更好的信息可能对委托人不利；4. 在有限期中模仿区间逐渐偏移。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了代理人策略性模仿行为在重复授权中的作用；2. 提出了模仿区间的概念；3. 挑战了信息越多越好的传统观点。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织中的授权决策提供理论指导，帮助管理者理解代理人策略性行为对授权效率的影响。

title: Attention to Satisfaction Journey: Apple Product Launches
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Attention to Satisfaction Journey: Apple Product Launches

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author affirms that this research was conducted independently and has not been influenced by any financial, professional, or personal interests. No conflict of interest exists regarding the publication of this paper.

detail.abstract: This paper examines the impact of Apple Inc., through its product launches in the world showcasing its consistent transformation from attention to long term satisfaction. Apple has been a global leader for years now, known for capturing the world's attention by carefully crafting marketing campaigns, high profile launch events and secrecy. By analyzing Apple's product launches, this study will take a deep dive into understanding the company's unique ability to generate desire through brand innovation, design and impactful storytelling. This research shows how their marketing strategies not only influence consumer behavior in terms of purchase decisions but also ensuring brand loyalty and advocacy. Their ability to foster user friendly experience, integrating a wonderful ecosystem and reinventing the product portfolio over time is what makes them stand out in the market. These findings will contribute to marketing literature by revealing how customer journey, personal selling, after-sales engagement and innovative modern designs can create a seamless experience from attention to contentment for a consumer.

AI.tldr: 苹果公司通过精心策划的产品发布会和营销策略，成功实现了从吸引注意力到长期客户满意的转变，建立了强大的品牌忠诚度和生态系统。
AI.research_question: 苹果公司如何通过产品发布会和营销策略实现从吸引注意力到长期客户满意的转变？
AI.motivation: 苹果公司作为全球领导者，通过精心设计的营销活动、高调发布会和保密策略持续吸引全球关注，但其长期客户满意机制值得深入研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 品牌创新理论、消费者行为理论、客户旅程理论、生态系统理论
AI.method: 通过分析苹果公司的产品发布会和营销策略进行深入研究

AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了客户旅程、个人销售、售后参与和创新现代设计如何为消费者创造从注意力到满意的无缝体验
AI.practical_contributions: 为营销实践提供了如何通过整合营销策略建立长期客户满意和品牌忠诚度的实用指导

title: Made in Ethiopia: Challenges in the Garment Industry’s New Frontier
affiliations: Geneva Center for Business and Human Rights and New York University (NYU) - New York University

detail.title: Made in Ethiopia: Challenges in the Garment Industry’s New Frontier
detail.abstract:
In recent years, Ethiopia has launched a bold economic and social experiment by inviting the global garment industry to set up shop in the East African country. Drawn by newly built industrial parks and a range of financial incentives, manufacturers for some of the world’s best-known brands—among them, H&M and PVH (Calvin Klein, Izod, Tommy Hilfiger)—employ tens of thousands of Ethiopian workers in a nascent sector the government predicts will one day have billions of dollars in sales. 

This report provides a close look at the flagship Hawassa Industrial Park, a vast and still only partly filled facility which currently employs 25,000 workers about 140 miles south of the capital of Addis Ababa.

For all of its potential, the apparel industry in Ethiopia has already encountered difficulties. The government’s eagerness to attract foreign investment led it to promote the lowest base wage in any garment-producing country—now set at the equivalent of $26 a month. On that amount, workers, most of them young women from poor farming families, cannot afford decent housing, food, and transportation. Even when factory owners provide additional modest payments for regular attendance and meals, workers struggle to get by. It’s common for young women to live four-to-a-room, without indoor plumbing.

Given relatively little training, restive employees have protested by stopping work or quitting altogether. Productivity in the Hawassa factories typically is low, while worker disillusionment and attrition are high.

Ethiopian politics are unexpectedly disrupting factory operations. Prime Minister Dr. Abiy Ahmed, chosen in April 2018 by Ethiopia’s long-time ruling party, has freed political prisoners and made peace with neighboring Eritrea. But the easing of repression has inadvertently unleashed previously bottled-up ethnic animosity. In Hawassa, local militancy has become entwined with labor issues, resulting in short strikes at individual factories and occasional park-wide closings.

AI.tldr: 埃塞俄比亚通过建立工业园区和提供财政激励吸引全球服装制造业，但面临低工资、工人生活困境、生产效率低下以及政治动荡等多重挑战。
AI.research_question: 埃塞俄比亚服装制造业的发展现状、面临的挑战及其对工人和社会的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 了解埃塞俄比亚作为新兴服装制造中心的潜力与现实困境，分析其发展模式对工人福利和社会稳定的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 全球价值链理论、劳动经济学、产业发展理论
AI.method: 案例研究法，以Hawassa工业园为研究对象，分析其运营状况和工人生活条件
AI.findings: 1) 工人月薪仅26美元，无法负担基本生活需求；2) 生产效率低下，工人流失率高；3) 政治动荡与民族矛盾影响工厂运营；4) 工人多为贫困农村年轻女性，居住条件恶劣
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了发展中国家在全球价值链中的困境，补充了关于低工资制造业对工人福利影响的理论研究
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供改善工人待遇、提高生产效率的建议，为国际品牌在选择供应链时考虑社会责任提供参考

title: Teaching Students to Write Well with AI (Even If You're Still Learning It): A Guide for Faculty Who Want to Teach - Not Play Detective
affiliations: University of Missouri School of Law

detail.title: Teaching Students to Write Well with AI (Even If You're Still Learning It): A Guide for Faculty Who Want to Teach - Not Play Detective

publicationDetails.detailsText: University of Missouri School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper No. 2025-50
publicationDetails.journalName: University of Missouri School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
As generative artificial intelligence (AI) tools rapidly enter legal education, faculty need practical ways to guide student writing and promote academic integrity.  This one-page guide offers concrete strategies to help faculty teach students to think and write more effectively with AI tools.  As students increasingly use AI on their own, faculty face two related challenges:  preventing misuse and promoting deeper learning. 

This guide frames the instructor’s role not as a detective, but as a coach who helps students use AI responsibly.  It outlines techniques to clarify expectations, promote good writing, and foster critical engagement with AI.  Adapted from the short article Did Your Student or a Bot Write This Paper? Teaching and Grading in the Age of AI, this guide includes a link to that article.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文提供了一个一页指南，帮助法学教育工作者指导学生使用生成式AI工具进行写作，强调教师应从侦探角色转变为教练角色，促进负责任地使用AI。
AI.research_question: 如何在法学教育中指导学生有效且负责任地使用生成式AI工具进行写作？
AI.motivation: 随着生成式AI工具快速进入法学教育领域，教师需要实用的方法来指导学生写作并维护学术诚信，同时面临防止滥用和促进深度学习的双重挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于教学指导理论，将教师角色从侦探转变为教练，强调通过明确期望和培养批判性思维来促进负责任的技术使用。
AI.method: 提供一页实用指南，包含具体策略和技巧，改编自相关文章《Did Your Student or a Bot Write This Paper? Teaching and Grading in the Age of AI》。
AI.findings: 指南提出了明确期望、促进良好写作和培养对AI批判性参与的技术方法，帮助教师有效指导学生使用AI工具。
AI.theory_contributions: 重新定义了教师在AI时代的教育角色，从监管者转变为指导者，为教育技术整合提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法学教育工作者提供了可直接应用的实用策略，帮助他们在AI时代更好地指导学生写作并维护学术诚信。

title: Disinformation and the 2020 Election: How the Social Media Industry Should Prepare
affiliations: New York University (NYU) - New York University

detail.title: Disinformation and the 2020 Election: How the Social Media Industry Should Prepare
detail.abstract:
This report assesses some of the forms and sources of disinformation likely to play a role during the presidential election campaign in 2020. While midterm Election Day in November 2018 did not feature much Russian interference, there is no guarantee that Russia, and possibly other U.S. antagonists, will refrain from digital meddling in the more consequential 2020 contest. What’s more, in terms of sheer volume, domestically generated disinformation now exceeds malign content from foreign sources and will almost certainly be a factor in the next election.

The report explores these risks and analyzes what the major social media companies—Facebook, Twitter, and YouTube (owned by Google)—have done to harden their defenses against disinformation. We also offer recommendations of additional steps the companies need to take to prepare for the almost-certain assault in 2020.

By “disinformation,” we mean a relatively broad category of false or misleading text or imagery which is intentionally or recklessly spread to deceive, propagandize, promote discord, or make money via “clickbait” schemes. For the sake of variety, we sometimes refer to “false content” or “false information.” 

We also refer to a narrower category of disinformation—“provably false content”— which we urge the social media companies to remove. To illustrate, consider these hypothetical examples: An article headlined, “The Sandy Hook Massacre Was Staged,” can be proven definitively untrue and ought to be deleted for that reason. By contrast, a story headlined, “Journalists Really Are the Enemy of the People,” may be unsubstantiated and misleading, but it isn’t provably false.

This report doesn’t cover cyberattacks — remote intrusions into computer networks, such as the Russian hack-and-release of Democratic email in 2016. Cyberattacks on campaigns and state voting systems are a distinct danger in 2020, but they are beyond the scope of this report. Also beyond the scope are the privacy and disclosure issues that led Facebook to agree in July 2019 to pay $5.1 billion in settlements to the federal government and to submit to new types of oversight.

AI.tldr: 本报告评估了2020年美国总统选举期间可能出现的虚假信息形式和来源，分析了主要社交媒体平台（Facebook、Twitter、YouTube）的防御措施，并提出了改进建议。报告重点关注可证伪的虚假内容，不包括网络攻击和隐私问题。
AI.research_question: 2020年美国总统选举期间可能出现的虚假信息形式和来源是什么？社交媒体平台如何加强防御措施？
AI.motivation: 2018年中期选举中俄罗斯干预较少，但2020年总统选举面临更严重的数字干预风险，且国内生成的虚假信息已超过外国来源。
AI.theoretical_framework: 虚假信息定义为故意或鲁莽传播的虚假或误导性内容，包括可证伪内容（应删除）和不可证伪但误导的内容。
AI.method: 风险评估和社交媒体平台政策分析。
AI.findings: 国内生成的虚假信息在数量上已超过外国来源；社交媒体平台已采取防御措施但需进一步加强。
AI.theory_contributions: 明确了虚假信息的分类标准，区分了可证伪和不可证伪内容。
AI.practical_contributions: 为社交媒体平台提供了针对2020年选举的具体防御建议，帮助识别和处理虚假信息。

title: The Health Impact of Policy Changes on Fleeing Driver Events in New Zealand: An Interrupted Time Series Analysis
affiliations: Victoria University of Wellington - Te Herenga Waka

detail.title: The Health Impact of Policy Changes on Fleeing Driver Events in New Zealand: An Interrupted Time Series Analysis

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author worked for an ambulance organisation at the time the project was initiated.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This work was undertaken on publicly available data which did not involve human participants. However, as part of an overarching program of work related to transport and police-related policy, HDEC approval was obtained from the Victoria University of Wellington Human Research Ethics Committee-2025/HE040619 - Road, Traffic and Policing: Policy-Related Health and Social Outcomes
declarations.funderStatement: Nil.

detail.abstract:
Background: In late 2020, New Zealand Police implemented a restrictive pursuit policy to reduce harm from fleeing driver events, a policy that was subsequently revised in May 2023 to allow for more officer discretion. This study quantitatively evaluates the impact of these two major policy changes on pursuits, crashes, and related health outcomes.

Methods: A quasi-experimental interrupted time series analysis (ITSA) was conducted on monthly data from January 2017 to March 2025. The primary outcome was the number of Crashes resulting from fleeing driver events. Secondary outcomes included Incidents, Pursuits, Deaths, and Serious Injuries. Segmented regression models, including a final interaction model for Crashes, were used to assess the impact of the December 2020 and May 2023 policy interventions. A comprehensive suite of sensitivity analyses and a formal Granger causality test were conducted to ensure the robustness of the findings.

Results: The 2020 restrictive policy was associated with a significant and immediate level reduction in Crashes (-19.04, p < .001). However, the May 2023 revision was associated with a large, immediate increase in Crashes (+73.99, p = .004). Critically, the effect of the 2023 revision was moderated by the number of fleeing Incidents; the policy's impact on Crashes was attenuated as Incidents increased (-0.070, p = .012). The findings were robust across all sensitivity analyses.

Conclusion: The restrictive 2020 policy was effective at immediately reducing crashes, but the 2023 revision reversed those gains. The moderating effect of Incidents on the 2023 policy's impact suggests a complex interplay between policy, enforcement activity, and outcomes. These findings provide critical, data-driven insights for law enforcement agencies on the real-world consequences of pursuit policy decisions.

AI.tldr: 新西兰警方2020年限制性追捕政策显著减少了逃逸驾驶事件导致的撞车事故，但2023年政策修订后撞车事故大幅增加。逃逸事件数量对2023年政策效果有调节作用。
AI.research_question: 新西兰警方2020年限制性追捕政策和2023年政策修订对追捕、撞车及相关健康结果的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 评估警方追捕政策重大变化对公共安全的实际影响，为执法机构提供数据驱动的决策依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政策干预效果评估理论，中断时间序列分析框架，政策执行与结果关系的调节效应理论。
AI.method: 准实验中断时间序列分析（ITSA），使用2017年1月至2025年3月的月度数据，包括分段回归模型和格兰杰因果检验。
AI.findings: 2020年限制性政策使撞车事故显著减少19.04起，2023年政策修订使撞车事故大幅增加73.99起，逃逸事件数量对2023年政策效果有负向调节作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了政策、执法活动与结果之间的复杂互动关系，证实了政策干预效果的调节机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为执法机构提供了关于追捕政策决策实际后果的关键数据洞察，支持基于证据的政策制定。

title: Do Gender Disparities Matter for Credit Access? : Evidence from World Enterprise Survey
affiliations: Ibn Tofail University, Ibn Tofail University, Ibn Tofaîl University, Kenitra, Morocco and Ibn Tofail University

detail.title: Do Gender Disparities Matter for Credit Access? : Evidence from World Enterprise Survey

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. The study uses secondary anonymized data from the World Bank Enterprise Survey.
declarations.funderStatement: The authors received no specific funding for this research.

detail.abstract: This study examines the impact of gender disparities on access to credit among female-led enterprises in Morocco, using firm-level data from the 2023 World Bank Enterprise Survey. Employing a quasi-experimental approach based on Propensity Score Matching (PSM), we compare credit access between firms managed or owned by women and those led exclusively by men. The findings reveal that gender inequalities do not constitute a major barrier to obtaining credit when the firm characteristics are comparable. On average, female-led firms are 9-13% more likely to secure a credit line than their male counterparts, depending on the matching method used. Factors such as firm size and geographic location exert a more significant influence on credit access than gender. These results challenge narratives emphasizing systematic gender discrimination in financial markets and suggest that broader structural factors must be addressed to enhance financial inclusion. Policy efforts aimed at expanding access to finance could serve as effective channels for promoting economic growth and fostering female entrepreneurship in Morocco.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用2023年世界银行企业调查数据，通过倾向得分匹配方法分析摩洛哥女性领导企业的信贷获取情况。研究发现，在控制企业特征后，性别不平等并非信贷获取的主要障碍，女性领导企业获得信贷的可能性比男性领导企业高9-13%。企业规模和地理位置对信贷获取的影响比性别更重要。
AI.research_question: 性别差异对摩洛哥女性领导企业信贷获取的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 挑战关于金融市场系统性性别歧视的叙述，探讨性别在信贷获取中的实际作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信贷获取理论，关注性别差异对企业融资的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用2023年世界银行企业调查数据，采用倾向得分匹配（PSM）准实验方法，比较女性和男性领导企业的信贷获取情况。
AI.findings: 在控制企业特征后，女性领导企业获得信贷的可能性比男性领导企业高9-13%；企业规模和地理位置比性别对信贷获取的影响更大；性别不平等不是信贷获取的主要障碍。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了关于金融市场系统性性别歧视的传统观点，强调需要更全面地理解信贷获取的决定因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供实证依据，建议关注企业规模、地理位置等结构性因素来促进金融包容性，支持女性创业和经济增长。

title: Setting Higher Standards: How Governments Can Regulate Corporate Human Rights Performance
affiliations: New York University (NYU) - New York University

detail.title: Setting Higher Standards: How Governments Can Regulate Corporate Human Rights Performance
detail.abstract:
In recent years, we have seen a wave of new regulatory frameworks, including legislation seeking to regulate businesses for their human rights impacts. 

Starting with voluntary initiatives like the UN’s Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights and more recently with the European Union’s Corporate Sustainability Due Diligence Directive (CSDDD), this report assesses the rise and key tenets of business and human rights regulation. It then provides recommendations to governments and companies on how to maximize the effectiveness of the legislation. Much of the regulatory activity has occurred in Europe, but this report argues for enhanced US government engagement. 

Central to our prescription is the idea that governments need to develop and enforce performance standards and metrics by which corporate compliance can be assessed and companies held accountable. Regulation is important, but without more data and means for assessing compliance and progress, regulation will not achieve its potential. Below is a summary of recommendations for governments and companies.

AI.tldr: 本报告分析了商业与人权监管框架的兴起，重点评估了联合国《工商企业与人权指导原则》和欧盟《企业可持续发展尽职调查指令》等法规，并提出了增强监管有效性的建议，特别是呼吁美国政府加强参与。
AI.research_question: 如何最大化商业与人权监管框架的有效性？
AI.motivation: 近年来出现了一系列新的监管框架，旨在规范企业对人权的影响，但这些法规需要更有效的实施机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 商业与人权监管理论，企业社会责任框架，监管有效性评估理论
AI.method: 文献分析和政策评估方法，对现有监管框架进行系统性分析
AI.findings: 大部分监管活动发生在欧洲，但需要美国政府加强参与；监管需要配套的绩效标准和评估指标才能有效。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了监管有效性的关键要素：绩效标准、评估指标和问责机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府和企业提供了具体建议，包括制定可执行的绩效标准和评估指标，以增强监管的实际效果

title: Achieving Hyper-Performance: The Role of Trust Calibration and Persuasive AI in Strategic Decision-Making
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Achieving Hyper-Performance: The Role of Trust Calibration and Persuasive AI in Strategic Decision-Making
detail.abstract: This study investigates the critical behavioral mechanisms underlying successful human-AI collaboration for achieving organizational hyper-performance a state of sustained superior agility, innovation, and adaptability. While AI offers immense computational power, its integration is hampered by a significant knowledge-behavior gap and prevalent algorithm aversion. Addressing this, we develop and test a novel theoretical framework, the Cognitive Synergy Loop, which integrates persuasive systems design with dynamic capabilities theory. Through a 2x2 between-subjects experiment (N = 210), we manipulate AI interface type (Standard Advisory vs. Cognitive-Synergy) and task complexity. Results indicate that the Cognitive-Synergy AI, designed to diagnose biases and deliver persuasive nudges, significantly enhances decision quality. This relationship is partially mediated by calibrated trust and is moderated by domain expertise, with stronger effects for experts. The findings provide robust evidence that designing AI to act as a collaborative coach, rather than an oracle, is key to unlocking hyper-performance, offering significant theoretical and practical contributions for the future of work.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发并测试了认知协同循环理论框架，通过实验证明：作为协作教练而非预言家的AI设计能够通过校准信任提升决策质量，特别是在专家中效果更显著，从而实现组织超绩效。
AI.research_question: 成功的人机协作实现组织超绩效的关键行为机制是什么？
AI.motivation: AI虽然具有强大的计算能力，但在整合过程中面临知识-行为差距和算法厌恶的障碍，需要解决这些问题以实现有效的人机协作。
AI.theoretical_framework: 认知协同循环理论框架，整合了说服系统设计和动态能力理论。
AI.method: 2x2被试间实验设计（N=210），操纵AI界面类型（标准咨询vs.认知协同）和任务复杂性。
AI.findings: 认知协同AI通过诊断偏见和提供说服性提示显著提升决策质量，这种关系部分由校准信任中介，并被领域专业知识调节（专家效果更强）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了认知协同循环理论框架，为人机协作研究提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为设计作为协作教练而非预言家的AI系统提供了实践指导，有助于实现组织超绩效。

title: Harmful Content: The Role of Internet Platform Companies in Fighting Terrorist Incitement and Politically Motivated Disinformation
affiliations: New York University (NYU) - New York University, New York University (NYU) - New York University, New York University (NYU) - New York University and Independent

detail.title: Harmful Content: The Role of Internet Platform Companies in Fighting Terrorist Incitement and Politically Motivated Disinformation
detail.abstract:
The internet does a lot of good for the estimated 3.5 billion people who use it today. But increasingly, harmful content contaminates the web, threatening democratic institutions and human rights around the globe.

In this white paper, the World Economic Forum Global Future Council on Human Rights focuses on two types of dangerous online content: terrorist incitement and politically motivated disinformation. Though emanating from different sources, both seek to distort the truth, discredit liberal institutions, and, in the words of the European Parliament, undermine “democratic values, human rights, and the rule of law”. 

Internet companies have resisted government content regulations. They justifiably worry that many states would seek to suppress dissenting views, undermining free speech online. The danger in this regard is all too obvious. A number of governments have blocked Facebook, Twitter, and Google. 

In the absence of government regulation, however, it is incumbent on the major platforms to assume a more active self-governance role. Corporate leaders should take responsibility to vindicate core societal interests, such as combating political disinformation and terrorist incitement, while elevating journalistic reporting and civil discourse.

ISIS and other terrorist groups have exploited social media in an unprecedented manner to recruit new members and encourage violence. The group’s digital propaganda has helped motivate an army of foreign fighters (once estimated to be as large as 40,000) to take up its cause in Syria and Iraq, and has inspired a range of devastating attacks by self-directed supporters overseas. 

With regard to the 2016 presidential campaign, American intelligence agencies have concluded that Russian agents systematically spread false information online and in so doing, undermined "public faith in the democratic process". "Trolls" posing as Americans used Twitter to push messages larded with made-up news and conspiracy theories. Facebook has revealed that fake accounts operated by Russians bought thousands of online advertisements on divisive social and political issues.

AI.tldr: 这篇白皮书分析了网络有害内容（恐怖主义煽动和政治性虚假信息）对民主制度和人权的威胁，主张互联网平台应承担更积极的自律责任来保护社会核心利益。
AI.research_question: 互联网平台如何在缺乏政府监管的情况下有效应对恐怖主义煽动和政治性虚假信息等有害内容？
AI.motivation: 网络有害内容日益污染互联网，威胁全球民主制度和人权，而互联网公司抵制政府内容监管，担心压制异见声音。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于言论自由与内容监管的平衡理论，以及企业社会责任理论。
AI.method: 案例分析法，分析ISIS利用社交媒体招募成员和俄罗斯干预2016年美国大选的实例。
AI.findings: 恐怖组织和恶意行为者系统性地利用社交媒体传播有害内容，破坏民主进程；互联网平台在缺乏政府监管的情况下需要承担更多自律责任。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了互联网平台自律治理的理论框架，平衡言论自由与内容监管的矛盾。
AI.practical_contributions: 为互联网企业提供了应对有害内容的具体建议，包括打击政治虚假信息和恐怖主义煽动，同时提升新闻报道和公民讨论的质量。

title: Toward Responsible Mining: Linking ESG Strategies with Spatial Analysis in Zambia's Copper Mining Industry
affiliations: , University of Cambridge - Department of Engineering, Independent, University College London - Institute for Sustainable Resources, Univ. Grenoble Alpes,  ISTerre, Independent, Independent, University of Cambridge - Department of Engineering and University of Cambridge

detail.title: Toward Responsible Mining: Linking ESG Strategies with Spatial Analysis in Zambia's Copper Mining Industry
detail.abstract: Concerns over the environmental and social impacts of mining have prompted the development of environmental, social, and governance (ESG) frameworks to guide companies toward more sustainable practices. While these frameworks have enhanced accountability and encouraged responsible mining, questions remain about their effectiveness in addressing localised impacts. This study combines a comprehensive review of mining-related mitigation measures with a geospatial analysis of Zambia's copper mining sector, integrating multiple datasets to evaluate environmental risks and social vulnerabilities. A novel quantitative scoring method is employed to assess mitigation options, utilising geospatial data that includes demographic statistics and infrastructure indicators such as roads, buildings, and public services, to identify socioeconomic challenges associated with mining activities. The analysis reveals significant regional differences: older mines in the Copperbelt Province face greater environmental and social hazards compared to newer operations in the NorthWestern Province. Factors such as historical land use, river systems, and infrastructure investment contribute to these disparities. Notably, modern mining sites like Trident exhibit lower population pressures and improved infrastructure, suggesting that stronger ESG compliance can help mitigate localised impacts. By integrating ESG mitigation strategies with geospatial analysis, this study offers a robust framework for promoting sustainable mining practices, with broader applicability to other resource-rich regions facing similar challenges.

AI.tldr: 本研究结合文献综述和地理空间分析，评估赞比亚铜矿开采的环境社会影响，发现不同地区矿山存在显著差异，现代矿山因更强的ESG合规性而表现更好。
AI.research_question: ESG框架在解决矿业本地化影响方面的有效性如何？
AI.motivation: 矿业对环境和社会的影响引发关注，ESG框架虽增强了问责制，但其在解决本地化影响方面的有效性仍有疑问。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境、社会和治理(ESG)框架，可持续发展理论
AI.method: 文献综述结合地理空间分析，整合多源数据集，采用定量评分方法评估缓解措施
AI.findings: 赞比亚铜矿地区存在显著差异：铜带省老矿山面临更大环境社会风险，西北省新矿山如Trident表现更好；历史土地利用、河流系统和基础设施投资是主要影响因素
AI.theory_contributions: 将ESG缓解策略与地理空间分析相结合，为可持续矿业实践提供理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为资源丰富地区提供可推广的可持续矿业实践框架，帮助矿业公司更好地管理本地化影响

title: Towards a Low-Carbon West Kalimantan: Budget Tagging Strategy for Reducing GHG Emissions and Improving Environmental Impact Assessment (IKLH)

detail.title: Towards a Low-Carbon West Kalimantan: Budget Tagging Strategy for Reducing GHG Emissions and Improving Environmental Impact Assessment (IKLH)
detail.abstract: The West Kalimantan Provincial Government is targeting a 27.99% reduction in greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions and an increase in the Environmental Quality Index (IKLH) to 73.21 by 2026. This target aligns with Indonesia's Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC) commitment as stipulated in Presidential Regulation No. 98/2021 concerning the Economic Value of Carbon. This study analyzes the effectiveness of budget tagging mechanisms for strategic programs and sub-activities in the agriculture, forestry, energy, and environmental sectors, involving the Regional Development Planning Agency (Bappeda), USAID SEGAR, and four locus districts (Sintang, Ketapang, Kubu Raya, and Sanggau). The results indicate that priority interventions include forest/land fire prevention, waste management, and monitoring of fertilizer and pesticide use. Budget tagging has been proven to strengthen synergy between provinces and facilitate data-based performance evaluation. This policy brief recommends integrating budget tagging into regional development planning documents and increasing local government capacity to optimize climate and sustainable development outcomes.

title: Spreading The Big Lie: How Social Media Sites Have Amplified False Claims of U.S. Election Fraud
affiliations: New York University (NYU) - New York University

detail.title: Spreading The Big Lie: How Social Media Sites Have Amplified False Claims of U.S. Election Fraud
detail.abstract:
The claim that Joe Biden did not legitimately win the 2020 election has evolved from a backward-looking Big Lie to an article of faith in the Republican Party that elections in the United States are generally corrupt. GOP nominees for state and federal office have elevated the falsehood to a central campaign theme in the 2022 midterms. 

Social media platforms have promised to protect the upcoming elections from mis- and disinformation, but their flawed policies and inconsistent enforcement result in the continued amplification of election denialism, especially in key battleground states. 

The consequences of denialism are grave. Beyond undermining trust in elections and other democratic institutions, the phenomenon is used to justify enactment of restrictive voting laws that disproportionately harm people of color. Denialism has also fueled harassment and death threats aimed at election administrators, causing many experienced officials to make plans to leave their jobs before the 2024 presidential election, a prospect that would increase the chances of logistical snafus and reinforce baseless claims of fraud. 

If even a handful of Republican deniers are elected this year to state offices that oversee presidential elections—such as governor and secretary of state—the 2024 process could descend into chaos and violence, making the events of 2020 - 2021 seem tame by comparison. This report assesses the role the major social media platforms have Executive Summary played in the spread of election denialism and recommends what they can do now to mitigate further harm to democratic institutions and norms.

detail.abstract: In an ever-changing global landscape marked by unpredictable crises, businesses face monumental challenges in ensuring continuity and resilience. This case study explores the strategic crisis and risk management manoeuvres of a premier private fashion enterprise in Qatar, which has been disguised as AMH. Anchored in the tumultuous experiences of the 2017 GCC crisis and the global upheaval caused by the COVID-19 pandemic, this narrative unfolds the tactics behind AMH's ability to not only survive but also navigate through these formidable periods. Furthermore, each crisis brings up various lessons to learn for the future, and the management needs to absorb these lessons and implement them in the future. It examines its crisis and risk management strategies along with the leadership skills shown during the 2017 GCC crisis and the Covid-19 pandemic. The case puts forward the measures taken by the firm to overcome the challenges by implementing effective strategies. By exploring how AMH's leadership harnessed the storms of geopolitical discord and a health catastrophe, this case study offers a compelling look into the importance of preparedness, agility, and the invaluable lessons drawn from the heart of crises that define the future trajectories of businesses worldwide.

AI.tldr: 本案例研究探讨了卡塔尔一家顶级私营时尚企业AMH在2017年海湾合作委员会危机和COVID-19大流行期间的危机与风险管理策略，展示了企业如何通过有效的领导力和战略应对机制在重大危机中生存和发展。

title: The Axiom Engine: A Fractal Framework for Anti-Fragile Governance and AI Alignment

detail.title: The Axiom Engine: A Fractal Framework for Anti-Fragile Governance and AI Alignment

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that they have no competing financial interests. The author does declare a non-financial competing interest in that they are the architect of the theoretical framework presented in this paper and therefore have a strong pre-existing intellectual commitment to its validity and efficacy.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This article does not contain any studies involving human participants or animals performed by the author.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This paper introduces the Axiom Engine, a novel philosophical and operational framework designed to address systemic decay in complex societies. The framework posits that by institutionalizing a fractal, self-correcting architecture based on the core pillars of Truth, Wisdom, and Humanity, systems from the individual to the global level can achieve anti-fragility—the capacity to gain strength from disorder. We first detail the philosophical architecture, which models ethical space as a tetrahedral field. We then describe its operational engine, a synthesis of cybernetic feedback loops and second-order observation. Subsequently, we demonstrate the framework's fractal scalability through proposed redesigns of personal ethics, the U.S. Constitution, the UN Charter, and a solution for the AI alignment problem. The paper argues that the Axiom Engine offers a coherent, scalable, and robust alternative to static governance models, providing a generative protocol for navigating 21st-century complexity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Axiom Engine框架，通过基于真理、智慧和人性三大支柱的分形自校正架构，使复杂社会系统实现抗脆弱性。该框架结合控制论反馈环和二阶观察，可应用于个人伦理、宪法、联合国宪章和AI对齐问题。

AI.theory_contributions: 发展了基于分形自校正架构的系统抗脆弱性理论，提出了伦理空间的四面体建模方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为个人伦理、宪法改革、国际治理和AI对齐提供了具体可操作的设计方案和协议。

title: False Accusation: The Unfounded Claim that Social Media Companies Censor Conservatives
affiliations: New York University (NYU) - New York University and New York University (NYU) - New York University

detail.title: False Accusation: The Unfounded Claim that Social Media Companies Censor Conservatives
detail.abstract:
Conservatives commonly accuse the major social media companies of censoring the political right. In response to Twitter’s decision on January 8, 2021, to exclude him from the platform, then-President Donald Trump accused the company of “banning free speech” in coordination with “the Democrats and Radical Left.”

Two days earlier, Trump had included the ideological bias claim in an incendiary address to supporters, some of whom then participated in a riot inside the U.S. Capitol. “The radical left tries to blacklist you on social media,” Trump said in his speech. “They don’t let the message get out nearly as they should.” 

This accusation—that social media platforms suppress conservatives— riles a Republican base that has long distrusted the mainstream media and is prone to seeing public events as being shaped by murky liberal plots. On a policy level, the bias claim serves as a basis for Republican attacks on Section 230 of the Communications Decency Act, the federal law that protects platforms from liability associated with user posts and content moderation decisions. 

But the claim of anti-conservative animus is itself a form of disinformation: a falsehood with no reliable evidence to support it. No trustworthy large-scale studies have determined that conservative content is being removed for ideological reasons or that searches are being manipulated to favor liberal interests. 

Even anecdotal evidence of supposed bias tends to crumble under close examination. Take Trump’s exclusion from Twitter and Facebook. These actions, while unprecedented, were reasonable responses to Trump’s repeated violation of platform rules against undermining election results and inciting violence. If anything, the platforms previously had given Trump a notably wide berth because of his position, seeking to appease him, despite his demagogic and routinely false claims. 

Trump has been the leading purveyor of the bias accusation, but it will not recede with the end of his presidency. In his quest to remain politically relevant, Trump almost certainly will continue to press the case via far-right media channels and/or right-wing online platforms like Parler and Gab. After getting kicked off Twitter, Trump said he might set up a platform of his own. Other Republican politicians likewise will maintain the accusation, in no small part because it resonates so powerfully with so many GOP voters.

AI.tldr: 该论文分析保守派关于社交媒体平台存在意识形态偏见的指控，指出这种说法缺乏可靠证据支持，实际上是一种虚假信息。特朗普等共和党人利用这一指控来动员选民基础并攻击《通信规范法案》第230条。
AI.research_question: 社交媒体平台是否存在对保守派的系统性偏见？这种偏见指控的性质和影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 回应特朗普和其他保守派人士关于社交媒体平台压制右翼言论的指控，分析这种说法的真实性和政治动机。
AI.theoretical_framework: 虚假信息理论、政治动员理论、媒体偏见研究
AI.method: 基于现有研究和证据的分析，包括对平台内容审核政策的审查和对偏见指控案例的评估

AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了意识形态偏见指控作为一种虚假信息的运作机制；分析了政治人物如何利用这种指控来维持政治相关性
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于社交媒体偏见争议的客观分析；帮助公众识别和抵制虚假信息；对《通信规范法案》第230条的辩论提供了事实基础

title: Islamic Blended Finance for Circular Economy Impactful SMEs To Achieve SDGs
affiliations: and

detail.title: Islamic Blended Finance for Circular Economy Impactful SMEs To Achieve SDGs

publicationDetails.detailsText: The Singapore Economic Review, volume 67, issue 01, 2022[10.1142/S0217590820420060]

detail.abstract: In this research, we present a framework for blended Islamic finance for impactful small and medium enterprises (SMEs) to achieve sustainable development goals (SDGs). The blend results from discussing the pertinent perspectives that underlie the motives of philanthropy, private sector activities, and public sector facilitation. The consensus of these three stakeholders on the impact criteria is an essential precondition for the blend to happen. Therefore, we first developed the consensus-based impact criteria for SMEs, namely, 4Zeros & SS (zero-waste, zero-emissions, zero-interest, Zero foreclosures and service to society). After that, we adopted a financial engineering approach to design products by blending the three motives. Financial contracts could be incentive compatible and effective if these three motivations are recognized and brought together. The purpose of our research is to offer such incentive-compatible structures that can mobilize funding for impactful SMEs, save cost as well as generate revenue for self-sustainability. In the contract design, the private sector provides finance, the philanthropist pays the costs of funds, the public sector facilitates, and the impactful SME gets subsidized financing. Since the blended nature of the contract provides a social subsidy to fund the cost element of the financing, the proposed structure creates a win-win result for the blending parties. While financial institutions expand into the SMEs sector for profitability, blended Islamic finance will attract additional resources toward enhancing development impact. Through the philanthropic component, SMEs, on the other hand, will access the source of social subsidy that will relieve the burden of the exorbitant commercial rates. The funding structure will reduce risk perception and spur growth. Consequently, this collaborative and innovative contract design will contribute to achieving multidimensional human development, as enshrined in the Maqasid al-Shariah, and the SDGs. Impactful businesses must integrate environmental, social and governance best practices as well as national development goals. Hence, the proposal offers several benefits and prospects of extended use for other consensus-based purposes such as low-cost housing, solar paneling, health, education, etc.

title: Digital Justice in Health Access: Algorithmic Governance in Kenya's Maternal Health Informatics

detail.title: Digital Justice in Health Access: Algorithmic Governance in Kenya's Maternal Health Informatics

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None.
declarations.funderStatement: None.

keywords: Linda Jamii Science and Technology Studies

detail.abstract: This research conducts a comparative conceptual framework analysis (CCFA) of Linda Mama and Linda Jamii, two prominent maternal health initiatives in Kenya that illustrate divergent digital logics of care: the welfare-state model and the market-driven model. Both projects utilise digital infrastructures, biometric registration, mobile platforms, and algorithmic management to improve healthcare accessibility. Nevertheless, they represent divergent moral and political ideologies regarding the criteria for deserving care, the implementation of dignity, and the recognition of various types of citizenship in the digital realm. Utilising Amartya Sen's Capability Approach, Nancy Fraser's theory of justice, and digital ethics frameworks, the study examines how each program defines justice, dignity, and inclusiveness in the context of digital governance. The analysis used CCFA to systematically deconstruct and compare the conceptual architectures of both frameworks through the examination of publicly accessible governmental documents, academic literature, and evaluation reviews. It examines how Linda Mama digitises the maternal body as a locus of public entitlement and surveillance, whereas Linda Jamii transforms poverty into data through market-driven micro-insurance frameworks, reconceptualising women as consumers of risk instead of citizens with rights. This comparative perspective uncovers the ethical contradictions of digitised dignity, illustrating how digital inclusion fosters visibility while exacerbating vulnerability. The article contends that both programs, notwithstanding their digital potential, may exacerbate structural imbalances if ethical and participative protections are not integrated into their design. It ends by asking for a digital health framework that puts justice at the centre and is based on African communitarian philosophies of care like Ubuntu, as well as on consent, data ethics, and inclusivity. By contrasting state and market paradigms of digital maternal care, the study enhances ongoing discussions regarding digital justice, algorithmic governance, and the moral economy of public health in the Global South.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过比较概念框架分析(CCFA)对比了肯尼亚两个重要的孕产妇健康项目Linda Mama和Linda Jamii，它们分别代表了福利国家模式和市场化模式的数字照护逻辑。研究发现，尽管两者都使用数字基础设施改善医疗可及性，但在照护资格标准、尊严实施和数字公民身份认知方面存在显著差异。研究揭示了数字化尊严的伦理矛盾，并提出需要基于Ubuntu等非洲社群主义哲学建立以正义为中心的数字健康框架。
AI.research_question: 肯尼亚Linda Mama和Linda Jamii两个数字孕产妇健康项目如何体现不同的数字照护逻辑？它们在定义正义、尊严和包容性方面有何差异？
AI.motivation: 数字健康项目在改善医疗可及性的同时，可能通过不同的治理模式强化结构性不平等，需要深入理解福利国家模式和市场化模式在数字照护中的伦理影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 阿玛蒂亚·森的能力方法、南希·弗雷泽的正义理论、数字伦理框架
AI.method: 比较概念框架分析(CCFA)，通过分析公开的政府文件、学术文献和评估报告来系统解构和比较两个框架的概念架构
AI.findings: Linda Mama将孕产妇身体数字化为公共权利和监控的场所，而Linda Jamii通过市场化微保险框架将贫困转化为数据，将女性重新概念为风险消费者而非权利公民。数字包容在促进可见性的同时加剧了脆弱性。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过对比国家和市场两种数字孕产妇照护范式，深化了关于数字正义、算法治理和全球南方公共卫生道德经济的讨论
AI.practical_contributions: 提出需要将伦理和参与性保护措施整合到数字健康项目设计中，建议基于Ubuntu等非洲社群主义哲学、知情同意、数据伦理和包容性建立以正义为中心的数字健康框架

title: Operational Excellence through Lean Manufacturing and Certification Standards
affiliations: Supply Chain Executive

detail.title: Operational Excellence through Lean Manufacturing and Certification Standards
detail.abstract: This paper analyzes the intersection of Lean manufacturing methodologies and global certification standards in achieving operational excellence. It reviews Lean principles, Six Sigma practices, and the integration of Lean Six Sigma as drivers of process efficiency and defect reduction. In parallel, it examines how standards such as ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, and ethical compliance frameworks like SMETA institutionalize quality, sustainability, and safety. Empirical evidence and case studies show that organizations that integrate Lean initiatives with certification systems achieve superior performance in productivity, quality, and market competitiveness. The paper argues that operational excellence is best realized through this dual approach: Lean methodologies provide continuous improvement momentum, while certification standards provide structure, credibility, and long-term sustainability.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了精益制造方法与全球认证标准在实现卓越运营中的交叉点。研究发现，将精益举措与认证系统相结合的组织在生产力、质量和市场竞争力方面表现更优。
AI.research_question: 精益制造方法与全球认证标准如何共同促进组织实现卓越运营？
AI.motivation: 探讨精益方法论和认证标准在提升组织运营效率和质量方面的协同作用，为企业提供实现持续改进和长期竞争力的有效路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 精益制造原则、六西格玛实践、精益六西格玛整合理论、质量管理体系理论、可持续发展理论
AI.method: 文献综述、实证证据分析、案例研究
AI.findings: 整合精益举措与认证系统的组织在生产力、质量和市场竞争力方面表现更优；精益方法提供持续改进动力，认证标准提供结构、可信度和长期可持续性
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了精益方法论与认证标准协同作用的双轨模型，丰富了卓越运营理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了实现卓越运营的具体路径：通过精益方法驱动持续改进，同时利用认证标准确保结构化和长期可持续性

title: Fortifying Global Supply Chains: Practical Insights on Risk Management and Operational Continuity
affiliations: Supply Chain Executive

detail.title: Fortifying Global Supply Chains: Practical Insights on Risk Management and Operational Continuity
detail.abstract: Global supply chains face unprecedented risks from pandemics, geopolitical events, cyber threats, and natural disasters. This paper explores strategies for building resilience and ensuring operational continuity in manufacturing supply chains. Drawing on both scholarly research and the author's leadership experience at Amazon, Givi Vietnam, Coepto, and QPack Far East, the discussion highlights the balance between Lean efficiency and resilience, proactive risk identification, cross-functional coordination, and the integration of predictive analytics and Industry 4.0 technologies. Case studies including Amazon's COVID-19 response and Givi Vietnam's quarantine strategy, illustrate how supplier diversification, contingency planning, and collaborative leadership sustain performance in crises. The paper concludes that effective risk management is not only defensive but also a source of competitive advantage.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了制造业供应链在面对疫情、地缘政治事件、网络威胁和自然灾害等风险时构建韧性的策略，强调在精益效率与韧性之间取得平衡，通过供应商多元化、应急计划和协作领导来维持危机中的绩效。
AI.research_question: 如何在制造业供应链中构建韧性并确保运营连续性？
AI.motivation: 全球供应链面临疫情、地缘政治事件、网络威胁和自然灾害等前所未有的风险，需要有效的风险管理策略来应对这些挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于供应链风险管理理论，结合精益效率与韧性平衡的概念，以及预测分析和工业4.0技术的整合。
AI.method: 结合学术研究和作者在亚马逊、Givi越南、Coepto和QPack远东的领导经验，通过案例研究（如亚马逊的COVID-19应对和Givi越南的隔离策略）进行分析。
AI.findings: 供应商多元化、应急计划、协作领导以及预测分析和工业4.0技术的整合能够有效维持危机中的供应链绩效。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了在精益效率与韧性之间取得平衡的理论框架，强调了风险管理不仅是防御性的，也是竞争优势的来源。
AI.practical_contributions: 为制造业供应链提供了具体的韧性构建策略，如供应商多元化、应急计划和协作领导，并通过实际案例验证了这些策略的有效性。

title: Regulating Social Media: The Fight Over Section 230 — and Beyond
affiliations: New York University (NYU) - New York University

detail.title: Regulating Social Media: The Fight Over Section 230 — and Beyond

keywords: and chief privacy officer at Microsoft
visiting fellow at Cornell Tech's Digital Life Initiative

detail.abstract:
Recently, Section 230 of the Communications Decency Act of 1996 has come under sharp attack from members of both political parties, including presidential candidates Donald Trump and Joe Biden. The foundational law of the commercial internet, Section 230 does two things: It protects platforms and websites from most lawsuits related to content posted by third parties. And it guarantees this shield from liability even if the platforms and sites actively police the content they host. This protection has encouraged internet companies to innovate and grow, even as it has raised serious questions about whether social media platforms adequately self-regulate harmful content.

In addition to the assaults by Trump and Biden, members of Congress have introduced a number of bills designed to limit the reach of Section 230. Some critics have asserted unrealistically that repealing or curbing Section 230 would solve a wide range of problems relating to internet governance. These critics also have played down the potentially dire consequences that repeal would have for smaller internet companies. Academics, think tank researchers, and others outside of government have made a variety of more nuanced proposals for revising the law. We assess these ideas with an eye toward recommending and integrating the most promising ones. Our conclusion is that Section 230 ought to be preserved—but that it can be improved. It should be used as a means to push platforms to accept greater responsibility for the content they host.

There are ways of improving governance of social media platforms that go beyond revising Section 230. One promising idea is to create a specialized government agency to improve transparency and accountability without interfering in particular content decisions. Facebook has suggested that a government body could monitor the “prevalence” of harmful content on various platforms, set benchmarks for such content, and impose sanctions for failure to meet the benchmarks. To pass constitutional muster, such plans would have to steer clear of the First Amendment’s prohibition of government action “abridging the freedom of speech.” We also analyze these ideas in the pages that follow.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了《通信规范法》第230条面临的挑战，主张保留但改进该条款，同时探讨了创建专门政府机构监管社交媒体平台透明度和问责制的可行性方案。
AI.research_question: 如何改革《通信规范法》第230条以及建立有效的社交媒体平台监管机制？
AI.motivation: 第230条面临来自两党的强烈批评，被认为对互联网平台的责任豁免过度，需要平衡平台创新与内容监管的关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于互联网治理理论、平台责任理论和言论自由保护原则。
AI.method: 文献分析和政策提案评估。
AI.findings: 第230条应当保留但改进，可作为推动平台承担更多内容责任的工具；创建专门政府机构监管平台透明度是可行的补充方案。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了平衡平台责任豁免与内容监管的理论框架，为互联网治理提供新思路。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了具体的改革建议，包括改进第230条和建立监管机构的可行方案。

title: Tackling Domestic Disinformation: What the Social Media Companies Need to Do
affiliations: New York University (NYU) - New York University

detail.title: Tackling Domestic Disinformation: What the Social Media Companies Need to Do
detail.abstract:
A growing amount of misleading and false content infests social media. A 2018 study by researchers at Oxford University found that 25 percent of Facebook and Twitter shares related to the midterm elections in the U.S. contained “junk news”—deliberately deceptive or incorrect information. A majority of this harmful content came not from Russia or other foreign state actors but from domestic U.S. sources. 

This report focuses on domestically generated disinformation in the U.S.: the nature and scope of the problem, what the social media platforms have done about it, and what more they need to do. Domestic disinformation comes from disparate sources, including message boards, websites, and networks of accounts on Facebook, Twitter, and YouTube. This homegrown harmful content flows from both liberals and conservatives, but overall, it is predominantly a right-wing phenomenon. Social media researchers have said that highly partisan conservatives are more likely than highly partisan liberals to encounter and share disinformation. 

Increasingly, social media platforms are removing disinformation from Russia and other foreign countries because of its fraudulent nature and potential to disrupt democratic institutions. In contrast, some commentators have argued that misleading content produced by U.S. citizens is difficult to distinguish from ordinary political communication protected by the First Amendment. According to this view, we shouldn’t encourage the platforms to make judgments about what’s true and untrue in politics. 

But the platforms are already making similar judgments when their algorithms rank and recommend posts, tweets, and videos. They also remove certain categories of harmful content, such as harassment and hate speech. We urge them to add provably false information to the removal list, starting with content affecting politics or democratic institutions. The First Amendment, which precludes government censorship, doesn’t constrict social media venues owned and operated by nongovernmental entities. The real question confronting the platforms is how to make their evaluations of factually questionable content more reasonably, consistently, and transparently.

AI.tldr: 该报告分析了美国国内产生的虚假信息问题，指出社交媒体平台需要更积极地处理可证明为虚假的政治内容，特别是影响民主制度的信息。
AI.research_question: 美国国内产生的虚假信息的性质和范围是什么？社交媒体平台对此采取了哪些措施？还需要做些什么？
AI.motivation: 社交媒体上误导性和虚假内容日益泛滥，2018年牛津大学研究发现25%的Facebook和Twitter分享涉及美国中期选举的内容包含"垃圾新闻"，且主要来自国内而非外国势力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于言论自由与内容审核的平衡理论，探讨第一修正案对社交媒体平台内容管理的适用性。
AI.method: 文献综述和案例分析，分析社交媒体平台现有政策和实践。
AI.findings: 国内虚假信息来自不同来源，包括留言板、网站和社交媒体账户网络；虽然来自自由派和保守派，但主要是右翼现象；平台已在通过算法排名和推荐内容时做出判断。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了社交媒体平台在内容审核中应更合理、一致和透明地评估事实可疑内容的框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议社交媒体平台将可证明为虚假的信息（特别是影响政治或民主制度的内容）纳入删除清单，并改进评估流程。

title: A Platform ‘Weaponized’: How YouTube Spreads Harmful Content – And What Can Be Done About It
affiliations: New York University (NYU) - New York University and New York University (NYU) - New York University

detail.title: A Platform ‘Weaponized’: How YouTube Spreads Harmful Content – And What Can Be Done About It
detail.abstract:
YouTube, the most popular social media platform in the United States, dominates user-generated long-form video-sharing around the world. Like other major platforms, it has a dual nature: It provides two billion users access to news, entertainment, and do-it-yourself videos, but it also serves as a venue for political disinformation, public health myths, and incitement of violence. 

YouTube’s role in Russia illustrates this duality. Since Russia launched its invasion of Ukraine in February 2022, YouTube has offered ordinary Russians factual information about the war, even as the Kremlin has blocked or restricted other Western-based social media platforms and pressured foreign journalists in the country to silence themselves. But for years before the brutal incursion, YouTube served as a megaphone for Vladimir Putin’s disinformation about Ukraine and its relations with the West.

Despite its heft and influence, less is known about YouTube than other major social media sites. A subsidiary of Google, YouTube has been less scrutinized by social scientists, politicians, and civil society groups, including ours. As a result, we know less about YouTube’s business practices and the effects they have on the societies in which it operates. This report seeks to address this knowledge deficit.

In Part 2, we examine YouTube’s role as the internet’s vast video library, one which has contributed to the spread of misinformation and other harmful content. In 2019, for example, YouTube reacted to complaints that its recommendations were pushing impressionable users toward extremist right-wing views. The company made a series of changes to its algorithms, resulting in a decline in recommendations of conspiratorial and false content.

But recommendations are not the only way that people find videos on YouTube. A troubling amount of extremist content remains available for users who search for it. Moreover, YouTube’s extensive program for sharing advertising revenue with popular creators means that purveyors of misinformation can make a living while amplifying the grievances and resentments that foment partisan hatred, particularly on the political right.

AI.tldr: YouTube作为全球最大的视频分享平台具有双重性：既提供新闻娱乐内容，也传播政治虚假信息和暴力煽动。本文通过俄罗斯案例研究YouTube在战争信息传播中的矛盾角色，并分析其算法推荐和商业模式如何影响有害内容的传播。
AI.research_question: YouTube在信息传播中的双重角色及其对社会的影响机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 相比其他社交媒体平台，YouTube受到的学术和社会关注较少，但其巨大的用户规模和影响力需要更深入的研究，特别是在虚假信息传播和平台治理方面。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社交媒体平台的双重性理论、算法推荐机制、平台治理理论
AI.method: 案例研究法（以俄罗斯为例）、内容分析、平台政策分析
AI.findings: 1）YouTube在俄乌战争中为俄罗斯民众提供真实信息，但此前长期传播普京的虚假信息；2）算法推荐改革减少了极端内容推荐，但搜索功能仍可获取有害内容；3）广告分成模式使虚假信息传播者能够获利。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对社交媒体平台双重角色的理解，提出了平台治理中算法推荐与商业模式相互作用的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供平台监管建议，帮助平台改进内容治理策略，提高公众对社交媒体信息传播机制的认识。

title: AI-assisted Programming May Decrease the Productivity of Experienced Developers by Increasing Maintenance Burden
affiliations: , Tilburg University, Tilburg University,  and Tilburg University - Tilburg University School of Economics and Management

detail.title: AI-assisted Programming May Decrease the Productivity of Experienced Developers by Increasing Maintenance Burden
detail.abstract: Generative AI solutions like GitHub Copilot have been shown to increase the productivity of software developers. Yet prior work remains unclear on the quality of code produced and the challenges of maintaining it in software projects. If quality declines as volume grows, experienced developers face increased workloads reviewing and reworking code from less-experienced contributors. We analyze developer activity in Open Source Software (OSS) projects following the introduction of GitHub Copilot. We find that productivity indeed increases. However, the increase in productivity is primarily driven by less-experienced (peripheral) developers. We also find that code written after the adoption of AI requires more rework. Importantly, the added rework burden falls on the more experienced (core) developers, who review 6.5% more code after Copilot's introduction, but show a 19% drop in their original code productivity. More broadly, this finding raises caution that productivity gains of AI may mask the growing burden of maintenance on a shrinking pool of experts.

AI.tldr: GitHub Copilot提高了软件开发者的生产力，但主要由经验较少的开发者驱动，且生成的代码需要更多返工，增加了核心开发者的维护负担。
AI.research_question: GitHub Copilot引入开源软件项目后，对开发者生产力和代码质量有何影响？
AI.motivation: 现有研究对AI工具生成的代码质量和维护挑战认识不足，如果代码质量随数量增加而下降，经验丰富的开发者将面临更大的审查和返工负担。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于开发者经验分层理论（核心开发者vs外围开发者）和软件维护理论。
AI.method: 分析GitHub Copilot引入后开源软件项目中的开发者活动数据。
AI.findings: 1) 生产力确实提高，但主要由经验较少的外围开发者驱动；2) AI生成的代码需要更多返工；3) 核心开发者审查代码量增加6.5%，但原始代码生产力下降19%。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了AI工具在软件开发中的双重效应：表面生产力提升可能掩盖维护负担向核心开发者集中的问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒组织在采用AI工具时需关注代码质量维护和核心开发者工作负担问题，避免生产力收益被维护成本抵消。

title: Making ESG Real: A Return to Values-Driven Investing
affiliations: New York University (NYU) - Center for Business and Human Rights

detail.title: Making ESG Real: A Return to Values-Driven Investing
detail.abstract:
Investing based on environmental, social, and governance factors— ESG investing—faces criticism from two main sources. Conservative U.S. politicians have tried to stir ill-informed hysteria over what they deride as “woke capitalism.” Separately, a very different group of skeptics that includes academics and journalists have relied on serious research and arguments to raise questions about whether current forms of ESG investing can deliver on their promises. 

Informed by these legitimate scholarly and journalistic critiques, we offer a dramatically different approach that can revive the original goal of ESG investing—namely, using investment decisions to create incentives for companies to conduct themselves in a more responsible fashion. 

The conceptual error at the heart of current ESG frameworks is that they measure how environmental and social risks may harm shareholders, rather than how business may harm the world. We show how this misconception developed historically and unpack the three reasons that it’s misguided. First, firms often take actions that harm society without shareholders suffering consequences. Second, enlightened ESG policies often add costs that investors are unwilling to tolerate because they reduce shareholder returns, although many E policies and some S policies may be cost-justified in the long-run. Third, centering ESG on financial returns misleads many investors who assume that a fund labeled “ESG” is values-driven. Instead they are fed exaggerated marketing claims by funds that are failing to achieve the traditional objective of protecting society. 

Much of the legitimate critical literature dwells on the incoherence of current ESG ratings. Scholars agree that the scores given to the same company by different ESG raters are deeply uncorrelated. ESG funds use any number of semi-secret rating frameworks, applying different weights to countless different metrics and criteria. Some of the most crucial data—for instance, on global value chains—is chronically missing or goes unmeasured. Firms that excel in one facet of ESG may lag in another, and the component factors often work at cross-purposes, yet the frameworks typically assign companies a single composite “ESG” score. With so much noise around the ESG signal, no one can quite tell what values investors are expressing or what conduct they’re encouraging.

AI.tldr: 本文批判当前ESG投资框架的错误理念，提出新的投资方法以恢复ESG投资的原始目标。作者指出当前ESG框架错误地关注环境和社会风险如何损害股东利益，而非企业如何损害世界，并分析了这种误解的三个原因。
AI.research_question: 如何重新设计ESG投资框架，使其真正实现激励企业以更负责任方式经营的目标？
AI.motivation: 当前ESG投资面临来自保守政治势力和学术界的双重批评，现有框架存在根本性概念错误，无法实现保护社会的传统目标。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于ESG投资理论、企业社会责任理论和利益相关者理论，批判当前以股东为中心的ESG评估框架。
AI.method: 采用历史分析和概念分析的方法，追溯ESG框架的发展历程，并系统解构其概念错误的三个原因。
AI.findings: 当前ESG框架存在根本性概念错误：1）企业损害社会但股东不受影响；2）ESG政策增加成本但投资者不愿承担；3）以财务回报为中心的ESG误导投资者。ESG评级体系存在严重不一致性和数据缺失问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了ESG投资框架的根本性重构思路，从"风险如何损害股东"转向"企业如何损害世界"，为ESG投资理论提供了新的分析视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和监管机构提供了重新设计ESG投资框架的具体方向，有助于恢复ESG投资的原始目标，真正激励企业承担社会责任。

title: The Influence of Suitable Leadership Styles on Nurse Performance: A Systematic Review
affiliations: ,  and Lambung Mangkurat University - Faculty of Medicine

detail.title: The Influence of Suitable Leadership Styles on Nurse Performance: A Systematic Review

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that there are no interests or conflicts from any party related to the writing of this review article.
declarations.funderStatement: No organization or institution funded the research or writing of this article.

detail.abstract: Background: Nurse performance is crucial to quality healthcare services, yet it remains a global challenge. Appropriate nursing manager leadership styles play a significant role in influencing nurse performance in hospitals. Objective: This systematic review examines the influence of proper leadership styles on nurse performance. Methods: A systematic review was conducted using the PRISMA guidelines. A literature search was conducted using Scopus, Web of Science (WoS), PubMed, and EBSCO databases from 2020 to 2025. A total of 846 articles were then selected based on original articles, studies conducted on nurses, and full-text articles in English. The final seven articles were screened and included in this systematic review. Results: Paradoxical, ethical, situational, transformational, servant, and authentic leadership styles have a significant positive impact on nurse performance through mediating mechanisms such as organisational commitment, empowerment, self-compassion, innovation, and job retention. Conclusion: Applying adaptive leadership styles to staff conditions and work situations is crucial for improving nurse motivation and performance. Therefore, developing nurse managers in various leadership styles is a key strategy for sustainably enhancing healthcare quality and patient satisfaction.

AI.tldr: 本系统综述研究发现，悖论型、伦理型、情境型、变革型、仆人型和真实型领导风格通过组织承诺、赋权、自我同情、创新和工作保留等中介机制对护士绩效产生显著正向影响。
AI.research_question: 适当的领导风格如何影响护士绩效？
AI.motivation: 护士绩效对医疗服务质量至关重要，但仍是全球性挑战，护理管理者领导风格在影响护士绩效方面发挥重要作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于多种领导风格理论，包括悖论型领导、伦理型领导、情境型领导、变革型领导、仆人型领导和真实型领导理论。
AI.method: 采用PRISMA指南进行系统综述，检索Scopus、Web of Science、PubMed和EBSCO数据库（2020-2025年），最终筛选纳入7篇文章。
AI.findings: 六种领导风格对护士绩效均有显著正向影响，通过组织承诺、赋权、自我同情、创新和工作保留等中介机制发挥作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统整合了多种领导风格对护士绩效的影响机制，揭示了中介变量的作用路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议根据员工状况和工作情境应用适应性领导风格，培养护理管理者掌握多种领导风格，以可持续提升医疗质量和患者满意度。

title: Fueling the Fire: How Social Media Intensifies U.S. Political Polarization – And What Can Be Done About It
affiliations: New York University (NYU) - New York University, New York University (NYU) - New York University and New York University (NYU) - New York University

detail.title: Fueling the Fire: How Social Media Intensifies U.S. Political Polarization – And What Can Be Done About It
detail.abstract:
Some critics of the social media industry contend that widespread use of Facebook, Twitter, and YouTube has contributed to increased political polarization in the United States. But Facebook, the largest social media platform, has disputed this contention, saying that it is unsupported by social science research. Determining whether social media plays a role in worsening partisan animosity is important because political polarization has pernicious consequences. 

In the U.S., where partisan divisiveness has reached new extremes, these consequences include declining trust in fellow citizens and major institutions; erosion of democratic norms like respect for elections; loss of faith in the existence of commonly held facts; and political violence such as the January 6, 2021, insurrection on Capitol Hill.

This report analyzes the evidence bearing on social media’s role in polarization, assesses the effects of severe divisiveness, and recommends steps the government and the social media industry can take to ameliorate the problem. We conclude that Facebook, Twitter, and YouTube are not the original or main cause of rising U.S. political polarization, a phenomenon that long predates the social media industry. But use of those platforms intensifies divisiveness and thus contributes to its corrosive consequences. This conclusion is bolstered by a close reading of the social science literature, interviews with sociologists and political scientists who have published studies in this area, and Facebook’s own pattern of internally researching the polarization problem and periodically adjusting its algorithms to reduce the flow of content likely to stoke political extremism and hatred.

Political polarization is a complicated concept. Democracy entails disagreement. Democrats clash with Republicans over taxes, immigration, and other issues, while demands for social justice may provoke controversy and backlash. In other words, in a democratic system, politics naturally creates some degree of polarization. But in light of the harmful consequences of the extreme divisiveness now plaguing the U.S., limiting polarization ought to be an urgent priority.

We focus on “affective polarization,” a form of partisan hostility characterized by seeing one’s opponents as not only wrong on important issues, but also abhorrent, unpatriotic, and a danger to the country’s future. This kind of hatred now infects American politics, and social media has helped spread the disease. But as we illustrate, affective polarization and its consequences are not distributed evenly across the political spectrum. Donald Trump’s presidency and his continued influence over many conservatives have helped push the right to further extremes than the left has gone. January 6 provides a vivid example.

AI.tldr: 该报告分析了社交媒体在美国政治极化中的作用，认为Facebook、Twitter和YouTube不是政治极化的主要原因，但会加剧分裂并导致有害后果。报告建议政府和社交媒体行业采取措施缓解该问题。
AI.research_question: 社交媒体在美国政治极化中扮演什么角色？它们如何影响政治分裂的程度和后果？
AI.motivation: 政治极化在美国已达到极端程度，导致信任下降、民主规范侵蚀、共同事实丧失和政治暴力等严重后果。社交媒体公司否认其平台加剧极化，但缺乏社会科学研究支持。
AI.theoretical_framework: 主要关注"情感极化"理论，即党派敌意表现为将对手视为可憎、不爱国的危险分子。
AI.method: 通过仔细阅读社会科学文献、采访相关领域的社会学家和政治科学家，以及分析Facebook内部研究模式和算法调整实践。
AI.findings: 社交媒体不是美国政治极化的原始或主要原因，但使用这些平台会加剧分裂并导致腐蚀性后果。情感极化在政治光谱中分布不均，右翼比左翼走向更极端。
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清了社交媒体在政治极化中的确切作用，区分了因果关系和加剧效应，强调了情感极化的概念。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府和社交媒体行业提供了缓解政治极化的具体建议，包括算法调整和内容管理措施。

title: Faculty Use of Artificial Intelligence in Teaching
