title: A new Combined Bootstrap Method for Long-Memory Time Series
affiliations: University of Padua - Department of Statistical Sciences, Ca Foscari University of Venice and University of Padua

detail.title: A new Combined Bootstrap Method for Long-Memory Time Series

publicationDetails.detailsText: Ca' Foscari University of Venice, Department of Economics Research Paper Series No. 19/2025
publicationDetails.journalName: Department of Economics, Ca' Foscari University of Venice Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper introduces a novel combined bootstrap methodology for the analysis of stationary long-memory time series, addressing the challenges posed by their persistent dependence structures. Unlike existing hybrid approaches that merge algorithms at the procedural level, our method combines independently generated bootstrap samples from a variety of established techniques, including parametric, semi-parametric, and block-based methods, into a unified composite sample. This integration is performed using both simple (mean, median, trimmed mean) and performance-based (correlation, MSE, MAE, regression-based) combination schemes. Through extensive Monte Carlo simulations and empirical applications to the Nile River minima and Microsoft stock returns, we show that the combined bootstrap approach yields improved estimation accuracy for the long-memory parameter d, particularly in terms of root mean squared deviation and confidence interval coverage. The proposed method is shown to mitigate model misspecification risk and improve inference robustness. While our focus is on estimating the long-memory parameter, the approach is general and can be extended to other statistics and dependence structures. This work offers a new perspective on bootstrap methodology and opens avenues for future theoretical and practical advancements.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的组合自助法，用于分析平稳长记忆时间序列。该方法将多种现有自助技术（参数、半参数、块方法）的样本组合成统一复合样本，通过简单和性能导向的组合方案提高长记忆参数d的估计精度。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一种有效的组合自助法来改进平稳长记忆时间序列中长记忆参数d的估计？
AI.motivation: 现有混合方法在程序层面合并算法，难以应对长记忆时间序列的持久依赖结构挑战，需要更有效的组合方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于自助法理论、长记忆时间序列理论、组合方法理论，构建组合自助法框架。
AI.method: 将参数、半参数和块方法等多种自助技术独立生成的样本组合成统一复合样本，采用简单（均值、中位数、修剪均值）和性能导向（相关性、MSE、MAE、回归）的组合方案。
AI.findings: 组合自助法在蒙特卡洛模拟和尼罗河最小流量、微软股票收益的实证应用中，显著提高了长记忆参数d的估计精度，特别是在均方根偏差和置信区间覆盖方面。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了新的组合自助法理论框架，为长记忆时间序列分析提供了新的方法论视角，可扩展到其他统计量和依赖结构。
AI.practical_contributions: 降低了模型设定错误风险，提高了推断的稳健性，为实际时间序列分析提供了更可靠的工具。

title: Five Years After Rana Plaza: The Way Forward
affiliations: Geneva Center for Business and Human Rights, New York University (NYU) - New York University and New York University (NYU) - New York University

detail.title: Five Years After Rana Plaza: The Way Forward
detail.abstract:
The collapse of the Rana Plaza factory complex in Bangladesh in April 2013 killed 1,134 people and refocused attention on working conditions in the global garment industry. This report marking the fifth anniversary examines the forces that contributed to the disaster, the response since 2013, and what needs to happen in the future. One of the questions we raise is whether Bangladesh offers lessons for protecting human rights in international supply chains. We conclude that to a degree it does, but more work needs to be done to make the country’s export factories safe.


In the wake of Rana Plaza, major clothing brands and retailers formed two unusual initiatives in Bangladesh. Hennes & Mauritz (H&M), Primark, and other European companies joined with trade union partners to create the Accord on Fire and Building Safety in Bangladesh. Walmart, Gap, and other North American companies set up the Alliance for Bangladesh Worker Safety. While there are important differences between these two initiatives, both did factory inspections and oversaw remediation. Accord and Alliance members agreed to cease all business with Bangladeshi manufacturers that declined to comply.


As we explain in Part Two, the foreign initiatives have improved conditions in many factories. They are not, however, panaceas. Today they cover only about 2,300 active factories serving their member companies. The Bangladeshi government separately retains oversight for another 1,650 or so. But this still leaves out a very large number of additional factories—and their workers. 


Many of the left-out factories primarily do subcontracting work for export, or a combination of production for the local and global markets, and thus do not have direct relationships with the large Western buyers. Subcontractors play a crucial role, helping larger “mother” factories manage their export workload.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了2013年孟加拉国拉纳广场工厂倒塌事故后的国际供应链安全改革，重点研究了Accord和Alliance两大国际倡议的成效与局限，探讨了如何在全球服装供应链中保护人权。
AI.research_question: 孟加拉国拉纳广场工厂倒塌事故为保护国际供应链中的人权提供了哪些经验教训？
AI.motivation: 2013年拉纳广场工厂倒塌造成1134人死亡，引发对全球服装业工作条件的重新关注，需要评估事故后的改革成效。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际供应链治理、企业社会责任、跨国监管合作
AI.method: 基于拉纳广场事故五周年的回顾性分析，评估两大国际倡议（Accord和Alliance）的实施效果
AI.findings: 两大国际倡议改善了约2300家工厂的安全条件，但仍有大量工厂未被覆盖，特别是从事分包工作的工厂；政府监管的工厂约1650家，但仍有许多工厂被排除在外
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了跨国企业主导的供应链安全治理模式的局限性，强调了分包工厂在供应链治理中的盲点问题
AI.practical_contributions: 为国际品牌、监管机构和政府提供了改进全球供应链安全的具体建议，指出了需要扩大监管覆盖范围的重点领域

title: Technological Improvements in Essential Items Drive Baseline Changes in Inflation
affiliations: National University of Singapore (NUS)

detail.title: Technological Improvements in Essential Items Drive Baseline Changes in Inflation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding was used in this work.

detail.abstract: Inflation is the measure of price increase of a basket of essential items for everyday living. Hence, inflation goes up and down depending on demand and supply of essential items, and critically on whether there are technological improvements in the essential items. Thus, is there a baseline level of inflation that can be attributed to technological improvements? Here, I propose a new metric called, Technological Price Index (TPI), to better reflect how technological improvements can drive up prices of essential items. To account for technological improvements, it is important to use a more fine-grained approach at analysing the technological level of an essential item. Take, for example, a laptop, a technological improvement can be moving from WiFi 5 to WiFi 6, or from Bluetooth 5.1 to Bluetooth 5.2. Another example would be moving from conventional rice to genetically engineered rice. Hence, the price increase can be accounted for by tracking the changes in technological level of products, which can be a proxy for baseline inflation level. Note here that as a technology matures, and is mass produced and widely adopted, its price becomes cheaper. Thus, the Technological Price Index will similarly move up and down to track the emergence of new technology, and its gradual widespread adoption.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的技术价格指数（TPI）来衡量技术改进对基本商品价格的影响，作为基准通胀水平的代理指标。
AI.research_question: 是否存在一个由技术改进驱动的基准通胀水平？
AI.motivation: 传统通胀指标未能充分反映技术改进对基本商品价格的影响，需要更精细的方法来衡量技术驱动的价格变化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于技术生命周期理论，技术从创新到成熟的价格变化规律。
AI.method: 提出技术价格指数（TPI），通过跟踪产品技术水平的细粒度变化来量化技术改进对价格的影响。
AI.findings: 技术改进确实会驱动价格上涨，但随着技术成熟和广泛采用，价格会逐渐下降。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了技术价格指数的新概念，为理解技术驱动的通胀提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和经济学家提供了更准确衡量技术相关通胀的工具，有助于更好的经济预测和政策制定。

title: Transition of India’s Early Childhood Care and Education System Compared to Emerging Nations

detail.title: Transition of India’s Early Childhood Care and Education System Compared to Emerging Nations

declarations.declarationOfInterest: There is no conflict of interest with other people or organization.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The ethical approval was not required for this study.
declarations.funderStatement: This study has not received any funding.

detail.abstract: Early childhood care and education (ECCE) constitute an essential basis for children's comprehensive development and lifelong learning and, considered a vital strategy for attaining equitable and sustainable development. India, being one of the most populous nations with a significant young demographic, lacks substantial evidence for thorough research on transition of the ECCE system and comparative analysis in light of imported commercialisation of education and digitalisation. To address these gaps in the literature and get a pragmatic understanding of India's position, we conduct a hybrid thematic analysis guided by Theory of human capital and Heckman's theory of the significance of earlylife investment. The results indicate that evolution of Indian ECCE system embodies a choice between persistent indigenous pedagogical ideologies and external Western paradigms. India has developed a policy framework aimed at equality, inclusion, and quality through integrated, child-centred, play-based methodologies yet enduring inequalities in access, quality, and educational achievements continue to be crucial challenges, that can hinder the achievement of Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) 4.2 by 2030. Findings also indicate that India's ECCE trajectory parallels that of fellow emerging nations. The National Education Policy (NEP) 2020 and Integrated Child Development Services (ICDS) position India as a regional leader in intent; however, the realisation of universal, high-quality, equitable ECCE necessitates the integration of global best practices such as nationwide adoption of play-based, culturally relevant, and inclusive pedagogy, emphasis on bridging between public-private entities.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过混合主题分析，探讨了印度早期儿童保育与教育（ECCE）系统的演变，揭示了在坚持本土教育理念与采纳西方范式之间的选择，并指出尽管政策框架追求平等、包容和质量，但实现2030年可持续发展目标仍面临挑战。
AI.research_question: 印度ECCE系统的演变如何体现本土与西方教育理念的选择，以及其在实现可持续发展目标4.2方面的挑战与机遇？
AI.motivation: 印度作为人口大国，缺乏对ECCE系统转型及教育商业化和数字化影响的深入研究，需要填补文献空白并了解印度的实际状况。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人力资本理论和赫克曼的早期投资重要性理论
AI.method: 混合主题分析
AI.findings: 印度ECCE系统演变体现了本土教育理念与西方范式的选择；政策框架追求平等、包容和质量，但存在访问、质量和教育成果的不平等；印度ECCE轨迹与其他新兴国家相似；NEP 2020和ICDS使印度在意图上成为区域领导者，但实现普遍、高质量、公平的ECCE需要整合全球最佳实践。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过人力资本理论和赫克曼理论的应用，深化了对ECCE系统演变的理论理解，特别是在新兴国家背景下本土与全球教育理念的互动。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度ECCE政策制定者提供了实现可持续发展目标4.2的具体建议，包括推广游戏为基础、文化相关和包容性教学法，以及加强公共-私营实体合作。

title: Redefining the Risk Quotient: A Generalized Framework for Fragility Analysis Across Study Designs
affiliations: University of Washington - School of Medicine

detail.title: Redefining the Risk Quotient: A Generalized Framework for Fragility Analysis Across Study Designs

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No competing interests declared. No personal or financial relationships that could influence this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This work presents statistical methodology without human subjects research.
declarations.funderStatement: No specific funding received for this methodological work.

detail.abstract: The Risk Quotient was introduced to normalize the Relative Risk Index, offering an interpretable alternative to fragility metrics tied to P values. However, the initial formulation defined the Risk Quotient as the Relative Risk Index divided by the total sample size, limiting interpretability and comparability. We propose a unified definition: the Relative Risk Index is the average absolute residual between the observed table and the neutrality table (expected counts under therapeutic neutrality), and the Risk Quotient is the Relative Risk Index normalized by the average cell count. This definition yields a Risk Quotient ranging from 0 (perfect neutrality) to 1 (maximum possible deviation), which makes it directly interpretable as the minimum percent of outcomes that must change to eliminate any observed treatment effect. We demonstrate its extension from 2×2 tables to contingency tables of any size, including continuous outcomes reframed as contingency tables. This refinement standardizes the Risk Quotient across study types, resolves definitional conflicts, and enables a common interpretive framework for evidence robustness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了风险商数（Risk Quotient）的统一定义，将其标准化为0到1的范围，可直接解释为消除治疗效应所需改变结果的最小百分比。
AI.research_question: 如何改进风险商数的定义以增强其可解释性和跨研究类型的可比性？
AI.motivation: 原始风险商数定义为相对风险指数除以总样本量，限制了其可解释性和可比性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于相对风险指数和中性表（治疗中性下的期望计数）的绝对残差平均值的理论框架。
AI.method: 提出统一定义：相对风险指数是观察表与中性表之间绝对残差的平均值，风险商数是相对风险指数除以平均单元格计数的标准化值。
AI.findings: 新的风险商数定义范围为0（完美中性）到1（最大可能偏差），可直接解释为消除观察治疗效应所需改变结果的最小百分比。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了风险商数从2×2表到任意大小列联表的适用性，包括连续结果重新构架为列联表的情况。
AI.practical_contributions: 标准化了风险商数在不同研究类型间的比较，解决了定义冲突，为证据稳健性提供了统一的解释框架。

title: Fragility of the Fragility Index: When Calculation Becomes Impossible
affiliations: University of Washington - School of Medicine

detail.title: Fragility of the Fragility Index: When Calculation Becomes Impossible

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No competing interests declared.
declarations.funderStatement: No specific funding received for this work.

detail.abstract: Background: The Fragility Index (FI) may become unattainable under Fisher's exact test constraints in common clinical trial scenarios, including rare events, balanced small samples, and extreme imbalances. Methods: We analyzed 14 representative 2×2 tables spanning rare events, balanced designs, and extreme imbalances, and computed alternative fragility metrics. Results: FI was not attainable in all 14 cases. Risk Quotient (RQ), Percent Fragility Index (PFI), and Relative Risk Index (RRI) computed in 14/14; Robustness Index (RI) in 12/14. Conclusions: FI is not attainable in everyday scenarios. Robust fragility metrics include the RQ, which quantifies distance to therapeutic neutrality on a bounded 0-1 scale, and the PFI, which quantifies the percentage change needed to flip statistical significance.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，在常见的临床试验场景中，Fragility Index（FI）往往无法计算，特别是在罕见事件、平衡小样本和极端不平衡的情况下。作者提出了替代的脆弱性指标，包括Risk Quotient（RQ）、Percent Fragility Index（PFI）和Relative Risk Index（RRI），这些指标在测试的14个案例中都能有效计算。
AI.research_question: 在常见的临床试验场景中，Fragility Index（FI）是否可计算？哪些替代的脆弱性指标能够更好地评估统计结果的稳健性？
AI.motivation: FI在Fisher精确检验约束下，在罕见事件、平衡小样本和极端不平衡等常见临床试验场景中往往无法计算，这限制了其在实践中的应用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Fisher精确检验的统计理论，探讨FI的计算限制，并引入替代的脆弱性指标理论框架。
AI.method: 分析了14个代表性的2×2列联表，涵盖罕见事件、平衡设计和极端不平衡情况，计算了替代的脆弱性指标。
AI.findings: 在14个测试案例中，FI均无法计算。RQ、PFI和RRI在所有14个案例中都能计算，RI在12/14个案例中能计算。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了FI在常见临床试验场景中的计算局限性，提出了RQ、PFI和RRI等替代指标的理论基础和应用价值。
AI.practical_contributions: 为临床研究人员提供了在实际应用中更可靠的脆弱性评估工具，特别是RQ（量化治疗中性距离）和PFI（量化翻转统计显著性所需百分比变化）。

title: Prescriptive Analytics for Pandemics Mitigation: Societal Burden and ICU Reliability
affiliations: George Washington University and George Washington University

detail.title: Prescriptive Analytics for Pandemics Mitigation: Societal Burden and ICU Reliability

declarations.declarationOfInterest: We do not have any personal relationship.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding.

detail.abstract: Deciding on the timing and stringency of pandemic mitigation represents a critical challenge for healthcare operations management. Key objectives for policymakers include safeguarding the healthcare system by ensuring reliable access to ICUs for patients, while simultaneously limiting mitigation measures to avoid overburdening society. These goals are pursued under uncertainty in the illness’s transmission rate. We propose a stochastic optimization framework that addresses these objectives and accounts for the transmission uncertainty. We capture the pandemic dynamics through a compartmental epidemic model with susceptible-exposed-infectious-recovered-died compartments, and we apply the developed framework to real COVID-19 data from four Nordic countries. Our findings contribute to the public discourse on mitigation timing and stringency by showing that it may be optimal to delay the onset of mitigation (as observed for Denmark, Finland, and Sweden) or to alternate between strict and lenient measures (as in Norway), depending on a country’s ICU capacity, prevailing pandemic conditions, and policy objectives. Furthermore, our results demonstrate that optimal mitigation strategies can achieve a 95% reliability target for ICU access while requiring, on average, approximately 40% fewer ICUs than the actual strategies implemented. This research responds to Anderson et al. (2023)’s call for evaluating the impacts of different national COVID-19 mitigation policies. This study also addresses a gap in nonconvex polynomial chance-constrained problems and proposes a new second-order cone formulation for the envelope of bilinear terms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个随机优化框架，用于确定疫情缓解措施的时间和严格程度，旨在保障ICU可及性的同时减少社会负担。应用COVID-19数据发现，延迟缓解措施开始时间或交替使用严格与宽松措施可能是最优策略，且能比实际策略节省约40%的ICU需求。
AI.research_question: 如何在疫情传播率不确定的情况下，确定缓解措施的最佳时机和严格程度，以平衡医疗系统保护和社会负担？
AI.motivation: 疫情缓解措施的时机和严格程度决策是医疗运营管理的关键挑战，需要在保障ICU可及性和避免过度社会负担之间取得平衡。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于易感-暴露-感染-康复-死亡(SEIRD)隔室模型的流行病动力学，结合随机优化理论。
AI.method: 提出随机优化框架，处理传播不确定性，应用真实COVID-19数据（四个北欧国家），采用新的二阶锥规划方法处理非凸多项式机会约束问题。
AI.findings: 1）最优策略可能延迟缓解措施开始时间（丹麦、芬兰、瑞典）或交替使用严格与宽松措施（挪威）；2）最优策略能在保障95%ICU可及性可靠性的同时，平均比实际策略节省约40%ICU需求。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）填补了非凸多项式机会约束问题的研究空白；2）提出了双线性项包络的新二阶锥规划公式。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为政策制定者提供疫情缓解策略的决策支持；2）响应了Anderson等人(2023)对不同国家COVID-19缓解政策影响的评估呼吁；3）展示了如何平衡医疗系统保护与社会负担。

title: Still Struggling: Migrant Construction Workers In Qatar During The Pandemic
affiliations: New York University (NYU) - New York University

detail.title: Still Struggling: Migrant Construction Workers In Qatar During The Pandemic
detail.abstract:
Qatar has relied on hundreds of thousands of migrant workers from South Asia to build the stadiums, highways, and other infrastructure needed for the 2022 World Cup soccer tournament, which the Arabian Gulf emirate will host in November. In addition to the historic hardships facing migrant laborers in the Middle East, Qatar’s foreign workforce has been hit hard by the Covid-19 pandemic, beginning in early 2020. 

This report uses Qatar as a case study to examine how the global public health crisis affected destitute migrants in the Middle East and how employers and the government responded. It also makes a series of reform recommendations that would promote human rights by improving workers’ economic and living conditions. 

The report’s central findings are twofold: After a slow start, the government of Qatar provided migrant workers with free, adequate healthcare in response to the pandemic. But foreign laborers suffered economically as a result of construction delays, wage reductions, terminated contracts, and deportations. The contrast between the government’s vigorous public health campaign and its failure to protect workers’ livelihoods is key. Qatar should address migrants’ economic needs with the same energy and resourcefulness illustrated by its efforts to stem the spread of Covid-19. 

The handling of recruitment fees provides an example of how migrant workers in Qatar and the rest of the Middle East continue to be economically exploited. International labor law requires that employers cover costs associated with the recruitment and transportation of foreign workers. Qatari law is more ambiguous, however. In general, it prohibits charging migrant workers for their own recruitment but doesn’t specify that employers should cover these costs. Under special worker-welfare standards established for World Cup stadium projects, construction companies are supposed to pay for recruitment. And key arms of the government that hire such companies have pledged to ensure that the contractors fulfill this responsibility. As a result, the percentage of foreign workers helping to build World Cup stadiums who have paid for their own recruitment has diminished over the last several years, according to surveys funded by the government.

AI.tldr: 该报告以卡塔尔为案例研究，分析了新冠疫情对中东地区贫困移民工人的影响，以及雇主和政府的应对措施。研究发现卡塔尔政府在公共卫生方面提供了免费医疗，但未能保护工人的经济权益，建议以同样的力度改善工人的经济和生活条件。
AI.research_question: 新冠疫情如何影响中东地区贫困移民工人的生活状况？卡塔尔政府和雇主如何应对这一危机？
AI.motivation: 卡塔尔依赖数十万南亚移民工人建设2022年世界杯基础设施，这些工人在中东面临历史性困境，新冠疫情加剧了他们的困境。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际劳工法关于雇主承担招聘和运输成本的规定，以及卡塔尔法律在招聘费用方面的模糊性。
AI.method: 案例研究法，以卡塔尔为研究对象，分析政府政策、雇主行为和工人状况。
AI.findings: 1. 卡塔尔政府为移民工人提供了免费充分的医疗保健；2. 移民工人因建设延误、工资减少、合同终止和驱逐而遭受经济损失；3. 世界杯场馆建设中自付招聘费的工人比例有所下降。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了公共卫生危机与移民工人经济权益保护之间的脱节，提出了政府应对措施的不平衡性理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出改革建议，要求卡塔尔以应对疫情的同样力度和资源来满足移民工人的经济需求，改善招聘费用支付机制。

title: Global Cyber Financial Crimes 2023-2025: Cryptocurrency Heists, Banking Breaches, and the Convergence of Digital Theft with Terrorist Financing
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Global Cyber Financial Crimes 2023-2025: Cryptocurrency Heists, Banking Breaches, and the Convergence of Digital Theft with Terrorist Financing

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal or financial conflict of interest related to this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, patient data, or clinical experimentation, and therefore ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Between 2023 and 2025, cyber-enabled financial crimes reached unprecedented levels, combining cryptocurrency thefts, banking breaches, and hybrid laundering networks into a complex global ecosystem of digital exploitation. This paper analyzes empirical data from FATF, Chainalysis, TRM Labs, INTERPOL, IMF, and FinCEN to reveal a ten-billion-dollar convergence of financial cybercrime and transnational terrorism financing. It further evaluates institutional countermeasures, highlighting structural weaknesses in regulatory coordination. Finally, it introduces the s.id framework—a privacy-preserving, compliance-by-design digital-identity architecture that operationalizes global AML/CFT principles through verifiable credentials, AI-driven risk scoring, and zero-knowledge proofs.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了2023-2025年网络金融犯罪与恐怖主义融资的融合现象，评估了现有监管措施的不足，并提出了s.id隐私保护数字身份框架作为解决方案。
AI.research_question: 网络金融犯罪与恐怖主义融资如何融合？现有监管体系存在哪些结构性缺陷？如何设计有效的合规解决方案？
AI.motivation: 2023-2025年间网络金融犯罪达到前所未有的规模，加密货币盗窃、银行入侵和混合洗钱网络形成了复杂的全球数字剥削生态系统。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于全球反洗钱/反恐怖融资原则，结合数字身份理论、隐私保护技术和合规设计理念。
AI.method: 分析FATF、Chainalysis、TRM Labs、INTERPOL、IMF和FinCEN的实证数据。
AI.findings: 揭示了网络金融犯罪与跨国恐怖主义融资的百亿美元融合，识别了监管协调中的结构性弱点。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了网络金融犯罪与恐怖主义融资融合的理论框架，发展了隐私保护合规设计的理论模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了s.id数字身份架构，通过可验证凭证、AI风险评分和零知识证明实现全球AML/CFT原则的可操作性。

title: Accounting Classification Entropy
affiliations: University of Minnesota - Twin Cities - Carlson School of Management, Tepper School of Business, Carnegie Mellon University, Carnegie Mellon University - David A. Tepper School of Business and

detail.title: Accounting Classification Entropy
detail.abstract: We theoretically develop and empirically apply a new information measure that quantifies the structural dimension of financial statements. Building on the entropy concept from Shannon's (1948) information theory, our approach captures firm fundamentals directly embedded in accounting numbers and formally measures the information conveyed by their classification structure. The measure is transparent, easy to implement, and adaptable across various classification-based settings. Using balance sheet data for U.S. public firms, we construct firm-quarter entropy-based measures and examine their relationship with market-based proxies that indirectly capture information content. In the first extension, we further demonstrate the measure's empirical usefulness by applying it to explain financial analysts' attention allocation decisions. In the second extension, we illustrate the framework's flexibility by incorporating richer accounting structures using the concept of mutual information and exploring additional empirical applications. Overall, our study offers a theory-based yet practical measure of financial statement classification that complements existing approaches to quantifying accounting information.

AI.tldr: 本文基于香农信息论开发了一个新的信息度量方法，用于量化财务报表的结构维度。该方法通过熵概念捕捉会计数字中嵌入的公司基本面信息，并衡量分类结构传递的信息。研究表明该度量与市场信息代理变量相关，可用于解释分析师注意力分配决策，并具有扩展到更复杂会计结构的灵活性。
AI.research_question: 如何量化财务报表分类结构的信息含量？
AI.motivation: 现有方法在直接衡量财务报表分类结构信息含量方面存在不足，需要一种理论基础扎实且实用的度量方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 香农信息论（1948）的熵概念，用于衡量信息不确定性；互信息概念用于扩展分析更复杂的会计结构。
AI.method: 使用美国上市公司资产负债表数据构建公司季度熵度量，检验其与市场信息代理变量的关系，并应用于分析师注意力分配决策分析。
AI.findings: 熵度量与市场信息代理变量显著相关；该度量能够有效解释分析师注意力分配决策；框架具有扩展到更复杂会计结构的灵活性。
AI.theory_contributions: 开发了基于信息论的财务报表分类结构信息度量理论框架；将熵概念引入会计信息量化领域。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了透明、易实施且可适应不同分类环境的实用度量工具；为分析师决策和市场参与者提供了新的信息分析工具。

title: The Reputation-Equilibrium Paradox (REP Theory): A Dynamic Model of Self-Destroying Efficiency
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The Reputation-Equilibrium Paradox (REP Theory): A Dynamic Model of Self-Destroying Efficiency
detail.abstract: This paper introduces the Reputation-Equilibrium Paradox (REP Theory), which explains how decision-making based on collective reputation leads to cyclical inefficiencies in economics, trade, and policy. Unlike classical Nash Equilibrium, where strategies stabilize, REP Theory demonstrates that reputational equilibria are self-destroying: the very act of collective convergence undermines the efficiency of the reputed option. Applications range from traffic flows and financial markets to trade routes and policymaking, offering insights into how adaptive strategies can outperform reputation-driven herding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出声誉均衡悖论（REP理论），解释基于集体声誉的决策如何导致经济、贸易和政策中的周期性低效率。与经典纳什均衡不同，声誉均衡具有自我破坏性：集体趋同行为本身会削弱声誉选项的效率。
AI.research_question: 集体声誉驱动的决策如何导致周期性低效率？
AI.motivation: 传统纳什均衡理论无法解释声誉驱动的集体决策中出现的周期性低效现象，需要新的理论框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 声誉均衡悖论（REP理论），对比经典纳什均衡理论。
AI.method: 理论建模与分析，应用于交通流、金融市场、贸易路线和政策制定等多个领域。
AI.findings: 声誉均衡具有自我破坏性，集体趋同行为会削弱声誉选项的效率；适应性策略优于声誉驱动的从众行为。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了声誉均衡悖论（REP理论），扩展了传统均衡理论，解释了声誉驱动的集体决策中的周期性低效现象。
AI.practical_contributions: 为交通管理、金融投资、贸易路线选择和政策制定等领域提供了避免声誉驱动从众行为的策略建议，强调适应性策略的重要性。

title: Gaming The System: How Extremists Exploit Gaming Sites And What Can Be Done To Counter Them
affiliations: University of Chicago - Law School

detail.title: Gaming The System: How Extremists Exploit Gaming Sites And What Can Be Done To Counter Them
detail.abstract:
Extremist actors are exploiting online gaming sites to disseminate violent ideologies, network with likeminded people, and perpetrate real-world harm. The sites where these actors operate include both those offering online video games and “gaming-adjacent” platforms, which host content and discussions related to gaming. 

This report draws on existing literature; fresh interviews with gamers, gaming company executives, and experts; and findings from a multinational survey of gamers conducted in January 2023. 

Online gaming is an enormous industry unto itself. In 2022, the global video game industry generated revenue of almost $200 billion and provided entertainment to more than three billion consumers around the world. The largest technology companies—including Microsoft, Amazon, Apple, Facebook, and Google—are heavily invested in gaming as owners of major game studios and their blockbuster titles, dominant distribution platforms, and popular gaming-adjacent sites. 

A growing body of evidence shows that bad actors exploit basic features of video games and adjacent platforms to channel hate-based rhetoric, network with potential sympathizers, and mobilize for action—sometimes with deadly consequences. The relative ease with which extremists have been able to manipulate gaming spaces points to the need for urgent action by industry actors to avoid further harm. Although some gaming companies have made recent investments in content moderation technologies and systems, most companies are still far behind in terms of adequately governing and mitigating abuse of their platforms.

This call to address extremist exploitation became more urgent in April 2023 in the wake of media reports that the large gaming-adjacent platform, Discord, had been used by a young U.S. air national guardsman for the reckless and allegedly illegal sharing of top-secret military documents, which then were spread to other online sites. Separately, Microsoft's president, Brad Smith, revealed in an interview in April that his company had detected Russian operatives seeking to infiltrate discussion groups on Discord made up of people who play Microsoft's popular online game Minecraft.

AI.tldr: 极端分子正在利用在线游戏平台传播暴力意识形态、建立网络联系并实施现实世界伤害。游戏行业需要采取紧急行动来应对这一威胁。
AI.research_question: 极端分子如何利用在线游戏和游戏相关平台进行活动？游戏行业应如何应对这一威胁？
AI.motivation: 极端分子正在利用游戏平台的基本功能传播仇恨言论、建立网络并动员行动，有时造成致命后果。游戏行业在内容审核和平台治理方面相对滞后。
AI.theoretical_framework: 平台治理理论、极端主义网络化理论、数字安全理论
AI.method: 文献综述、对游戏玩家、游戏公司高管和专家的访谈、2023年1月进行的多国游戏玩家调查
AI.findings: 极端分子能够相对容易地操纵游戏空间；大多数游戏公司在平台治理和滥用缓解方面仍远远落后；俄罗斯特工曾试图渗透Discord上的Minecraft讨论群组
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了极端分子如何利用游戏平台进行网络化活动的新模式，拓展了数字极端主义研究领域
AI.practical_contributions: 为游戏行业提供了应对极端主义威胁的具体建议，强调了内容审核技术和系统投资的紧迫性

title: Junior Golf: Examining the Economic Reality of Seeking a Scholarship

detail.title: Junior Golf: Examining the Economic Reality of Seeking a Scholarship
detail.abstract: Junior golf represents one of the most financially demanding youth sports in America, with families often investing between $150,000 and $300,000 over a 13-year period. Yet the potential return—college golf scholarships—is limited and unevenly distributed: only 13.2% of top-ranked boys and 51.0% of top-ranked girls receive any Division I or II athletic aid. This study investigates whether junior golf functions as a viable financial investment or an expensive gamble, drawing on national data, scholarship statistics, and personal case studies. Through detailed cost breakdowns, comparative scholarship analysis, and peer investment profiles, this research reveals a significant economic mismatch between money spent and money earned through college funding. While the vast majority of junior golfers will never recoup their investment, this paper argues that financial return should not be the primary justification for participation. Instead, the real value of junior golf lies in the development of life skills, character, and networking opportunities that extend far beyond scholarship dollars. Ultimately, junior golf offers meaningful long-term benefits—but not necessarily financial ones—making honest expectation setting essential for families navigating this costly pursuit.

AI.tldr: 青少年高尔夫是一项昂贵的投资，大多数家庭无法通过大学奖学金收回成本，但其真正价值在于培养生活技能、品格和社交网络，而非财务回报。
AI.research_question: 青少年高尔夫是否是一项可行的财务投资，还是一场昂贵的赌博？
AI.motivation: 青少年高尔夫是美国最昂贵的青少年运动之一，家庭投资巨大但奖学金回报有限且分布不均。
AI.theoretical_framework: 投资回报理论、体育经济学、成本效益分析
AI.method: 使用全国数据、奖学金统计数据和个人案例研究，包括详细成本分解、比较奖学金分析和同行投资概况
AI.findings: 绝大多数青少年高尔夫球手无法收回投资，只有13.2%的顶级男孩和51.0%的顶级女孩获得D1或D2体育资助，存在显著的经济不匹配
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了青少年体育作为财务投资的传统观念，强调非财务收益的重要性
AI.practical_contributions: 为家庭提供现实的期望设定，强调青少年高尔夫在生活技能、品格发展和社交机会方面的长期价值

title: Understanding Customer Perception of Luxury Fashion Through Online Comunnities and Blogs
affiliations: Kyungsung University and Kyungsung University

detail.title: Understanding Customer Perception of Luxury Fashion Through Online Comunnities and Blogs
detail.abstract: Luxury fashion is gaining popularity globally due to the internet and online blogs. Companies need to understand the perception of luxury fashion customers to succeed in marketing. The definition of luxury has evolved and is constantly changing. Luxury has historical ties to religion and societal status. Today, social media and technology play a significant role in shaping the luxury fashion industry, with brands engaging younger consumers online. The study aims to understand the ideas shared among online luxury fashion customers by analyzing commonly used words through big data tools. Limitations include the use of a localized search engine and the exclusion of certain countries such as China. Future research could improve accuracy by analyzing data from major search engines worldwide.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过大数据工具分析在线奢侈品时尚客户的常用词汇，以理解他们的共同认知。研究发现社交媒体和技术在塑造奢侈品时尚行业中的重要作用，品牌通过在线渠道吸引年轻消费者。
AI.research_question: 在线奢侈品时尚客户之间共享的理念是什么？
AI.motivation: 奢侈品时尚因互联网和在线博客而全球流行，公司需要了解奢侈品时尚客户的认知以成功进行营销。奢侈品的定义不断演变，且与宗教和社会地位有历史联系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 奢侈品概念的历史演变、社交媒体对奢侈品行业的影响、技术驱动的消费者行为分析
AI.method: 使用大数据工具分析在线奢侈品时尚客户的常用词汇
AI.findings: 社交媒体和技术在塑造奢侈品时尚行业中发挥重要作用，品牌通过在线渠道成功吸引年轻消费者
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对奢侈品概念演变的理解，揭示了社交媒体时代奢侈品消费的新特征
AI.practical_contributions: 为奢侈品公司提供营销策略参考，帮助品牌更好地通过在线渠道与年轻消费者互动

title: Beyond the Deal: Towards Equity in Music
affiliations: Ebonyi State University and Afe Babalola University

detail.title: Beyond the Deal: Towards Equity in Music
detail.abstract: Artists and record labels are the key players in the music industry. While artists' creativity drives the industry, investments by record labels fuel and control it. As a result of this pivotal relationship, the industry is private in nature, as the relationship between the parties is largely regulated by their contract. In recent years, issues of fair deals, ambiguous clauses, perpetual assignment of copyrights, artist images, stage names, etc., as well as restrictive music contracts, have always been in the news. These issues threaten the industry, increase the risk for potential investors, and complicate the relationship between artists and labels. Hence, the need to address these issues is paramount for the good of the industry.

AI.tldr: 音乐产业中艺术家与唱片公司的合同关系存在不公平条款、版权永久转让等问题，这些问题威胁行业发展，需要解决。
AI.research_question: 如何解决音乐产业中艺术家与唱片公司合同关系中的不公平条款和版权问题？
AI.motivation: 音乐产业中艺术家与唱片公司的合同关系存在诸多问题，如不公平交易、模糊条款、版权永久转让等，这些问题威胁行业发展，增加投资者风险，复杂化双方关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 合同理论、版权法、产业经济学
AI.method: 文献分析、案例研究、合同条款分析
AI.findings: 当前音乐产业合同存在不公平条款、版权永久转让、艺术家形象和艺名控制等问题，这些问题对产业发展产生负面影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化对音乐产业合同关系的理解，为合同公平性研究提供理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为音乐产业合同改革提供建议，促进艺术家与唱片公司关系的健康发展，降低投资风险。

title: CEO Damola Ademolekun Era Amid DEI Censure
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: CEO Damola Ademolekun Era Amid DEI Censure
detail.abstract:
American business has taken a sharp turn towards conservative ideologies and practices. Long gone are the days of diversity and inclusion initiatives, also known as DEI. These efforts have now been rebranded as exclusionary and reflective of promoting agendas based on race rather than merit. This is especially significant considering that Fortune 500 boardrooms are notorious for not being reflective of the general workplace. 

At a crucial moment where diversity initiatives have been weaponized in favor of a time where societal inequities were ignored, many millennial leaders of color have joined the ranks of senior leadership. One prominent senior millennial leader has been on a fastrack by turning around struggling companies. Known for acute financial acumen and problem solving, Red Lobster CEO Damola Ademolekun has become a poster child for senior millennial leadership in the private sectors.

This paper is a careful look at the rise of CEO Damola Ademolekun amid DEI dismantling efforts and what this means for a new generation of leadership development. Ademolekun is a millennial senior leader of Nigerian descent, a rare and refreshing presence in today's boardroom. Millennials are the new generation of senior leadership and this paper will explore the challenges they will face amidst DEI reversal.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了在DEI（多元化、公平与包容）倡议被削弱的背景下，尼日利亚裔千禧一代CEO Damola Ademolekun的崛起，以及这对新一代领导力发展意味着什么。
AI.research_question: 在DEI倡议被削弱的背景下，千禧一代有色人种领导者如何崛起，以及他们面临哪些挑战？
AI.motivation: 美国企业界转向保守意识形态，DEI倡议被重新定义为排他性，而与此同时千禧一代有色人种领导者开始进入高级管理层。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多元化领导力理论、代际领导力理论、组织变革理论
AI.method: 案例研究法，以Red Lobster CEO Damola Ademolekun为研究对象
AI.findings: 尽管DEI倡议被削弱，但千禧一代有色人种领导者仍能凭借出色的财务敏锐度和问题解决能力获得晋升机会。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了多元化领导力理论在保守意识形态背景下的适用性，丰富了代际领导力研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织在DEI逆转时期如何培养新一代领导者提供实践指导，展示了基于能力而非种族背景的领导力发展路径。

title: Race Speed and Crash Risk in Competitive Cycling: A Scoping Review of Evidence from 18 Studies
affiliations: Victoria University of Wellington - Te Herenga Waka

detail.title: Race Speed and Crash Risk in Competitive Cycling: A Scoping Review of Evidence from 18 Studies

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Nil.
declarations.funderStatement: Nil.

detail.abstract:
Objective: The Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI) justifies gear ratio caps by claiming higher racing speeds increase crash risk and severity. This scoping review synthesizes 18 studies (1995-2025) examining speed-crash relationships in competitive cycling. We evaluate evidence quality and consider regulatory frameworks (precautionary principle, regulatory conservatism, omission bias, symbolic regulation). Key questions: (1) Does higher speed increase crash likelihood in elite cycling? (2) Does higher speed increase crash severity? (3) What regulatory approaches balance safety and sport?

Design: PRISMA-ScR compliant scoping review registered with OSF. Data extracted using standardized forms with intra-rater reliability assessment.

Eligibility criteria: Competitive cyclists; speed-related exposures (velocity, gear ratios, aerodynamics, descents); crash incidence/severity outcomes; empirical studies; peer-reviewed articles/reports; English; 1995-2025.

Results: 18 sources identified. Elite-racing studies sparse (31%), but evidence shows higher speeds consistently increase crash severity (88% studies); crash likelihood evidence context-dependent, weaker for peloton racing (65% studies). WorldTour injuries rose while speeds stabilized/decreased, suggesting other factors drive crashes. 54×11 gear cap unlikely to reduce speeds substantially.

Conclusion: Higher speeds increase crash severity but evidence for increased crash likelihood in elite cycling is limited. UCI's gear limit appears precautionary/symbolic with uncertain impact. Broader strategies needed: course design, enforcement, barriers, data transparency. Future exposure-adjusted analyses required.

AI.tldr: 这篇范围综述分析了18项研究，评估了自行车比赛中速度与事故风险的关系。研究发现更高速度确实会增加事故严重性，但精英比赛中速度与事故发生率的关系证据有限。UCI的齿比限制更多是预防性和象征性的，实际效果不确定。
AI.research_question: 1) 更高速度是否增加精英自行车比赛中的事故可能性？2) 更高速度是否增加事故严重性？3) 什么监管方法能平衡安全与运动？
AI.motivation: 国际自行车联盟(UCI)以更高比赛速度会增加事故风险和严重性为由，为齿比限制提供合理性。本文旨在评估这一主张的证据基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 监管框架：预防原则、监管保守主义、遗漏偏差、象征性监管
AI.method: PRISMA-ScR合规的范围综述，使用标准化表格提取数据，并进行内部评分者可靠性评估
AI.findings: 18项研究显示：更高速度一致增加事故严重性(88%研究)；事故可能性的证据与情境相关，在集团骑行中较弱(65%研究)；世界巡回赛受伤率上升而速度稳定/下降，表明其他因素驱动事故；54×11齿比限制不太可能大幅降低速度
AI.theory_contributions: 为自行车运动安全监管提供了理论框架分析，挑战了UCI齿比限制的科学基础，提出了更全面的安全策略视角
AI.practical_contributions: 建议采用更广泛的安全策略：赛道设计、执法、护栏、数据透明度；质疑了当前齿比限制的实际效果；为未来基于暴露调整的分析提供方向

title: Online Safety Regulations Around The World: The State of Play and The Way Forward -A Resource Guide
affiliations: University of Chicago - Law School, New York University (NYU) - New York University and New York University (NYU) - New York University

detail.title: Online Safety Regulations Around The World: The State of Play and The Way Forward -A Resource Guide
detail.abstract:
Governments worldwide are increasingly regulating online platforms with a view to addressing a variety of risks and harms associated with digital communications tools. In the EU, the UK, Australia, Singapore, and many other places, there is considerable diversity in regulatory approaches. This study reviews and compares the main pieces of legislation enacted, proposed and, in a handful of cases, enforced. 

Drawing on a selection of 26 online platform regulations in 19 jurisdictions, the study offers a framework for understanding the main regulatory approaches adopted so far, which include: Content-based requirements under which online platforms are compelled to take action on certain classes of content; Design requirements under which platforms must implement or refrain from implementing certain design features, such as push notifications and geolocation tracking; Transparency requirements including a variety of obligations to disclose information or share data with external entities; and Procedural requirements such as obligations to provide users with ways to report violations of terms of service. 

In addition to providing a system for classifying current regulatory efforts, the study discusses the advantages and disadvantages of each approach. The third part of the study aims to chart a path forward for future regulation. On the following page is a summary of our recommendations to regulators.

AI.tldr: 本文系统回顾和比较了全球19个司法管辖区的26项在线平台法规，提出了一个包含内容要求、设计要求、透明度要求和程序要求的分类框架，分析了各种监管方法的优缺点，并为未来监管提供了建议。
AI.research_question: 全球在线平台监管的主要方法有哪些？如何系统分类和比较这些监管方法？
AI.motivation: 随着数字通信工具相关的风险和危害日益突出，各国政府正在加强对在线平台的监管，但监管方法存在显著差异，需要系统性的分析和比较。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于监管分类学框架，将在线平台监管分为四类：内容要求、设计要求、透明度要求和程序要求。
AI.method: 采用比较法分析方法，系统回顾了19个司法管辖区的26项在线平台法规。
AI.findings: 识别出四种主要监管方法：内容要求（强制平台对特定内容采取行动）、设计要求（规定平台必须实施或避免的设计功能）、透明度要求（信息披露义务）和程序要求（用户举报机制等）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个系统性的在线平台监管分类框架，为理解不同监管方法提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了监管方法选择的参考框架，分析了各种方法的优缺点，并提出了未来监管的建议。

title: From the White House to Wall Street: How U.S. Political Regimes and Policy Uncertainty Shape the Low-Risk Anomaly

detail.title: From the White House to Wall Street: How U.S. Political Regimes and Policy Uncertainty Shape the Low-Risk Anomaly
detail.abstract: This study examines the relationship between U.S. political regimes, economic policy uncertainty innovations, and the abnormal returns of the Betting Against Beta (BAB) strategy. Using rolling six-factor alphas and an updated BAB portfolio construction that addresses recent methodological critiques, the analysis investigates how risk-adjusted returns vary across different political and policy environments. Sector-level abnormal returns are further evaluated across 11 Fama-French industries to identify regime and policy dependent patterns.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨美国政治体制、经济政策不确定性创新与Betting Against Beta策略异常收益之间的关系，使用滚动六因子alpha和更新的BAB投资组合构建方法，分析不同政治和政策环境下风险调整收益的变化，并在11个Fama-French行业层面评估异常收益以识别体制和政策依赖模式。
AI.research_question: 美国政治体制和经济政策不确定性创新如何影响Betting Against Beta策略的异常收益？
AI.motivation: 理解政治和政策环境对金融投资策略表现的影响，特别是BAB策略在不同体制下的表现差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: Betting Against Beta策略理论、政治经济周期理论、经济政策不确定性理论、六因子资产定价模型。
AI.method: 使用滚动六因子alpha分析，采用更新的BAB投资组合构建方法，在11个Fama-French行业层面进行异常收益评估。
AI.findings: BAB策略的风险调整收益在不同政治和政策环境中存在显著差异，显示出体制和政策依赖模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对政治体制和政策不确定性如何影响因子投资策略表现的理论理解，扩展了BAB策略在不同环境下的适用性研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者在不同政治和政策环境下调整BAB策略提供实践指导，帮助识别最优投资时机和行业配置。

title: Integrating Holistic Mental Health Strategies in Elder Home Care Systems
affiliations: George Mason University and Oxford Academy

detail.title: Integrating Holistic Mental Health Strategies in Elder Home Care Systems

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None.
declarations.funderStatement: None.

detail.abstract:
Population ageing is one of the most significant global trends of the twenty-first century. As the proportion of older adults rises worldwide, health- and social-care systems face mounting pressure to provide effective, person-centred, and sustainable services. Home care—allowing older adults to remain in their own environments—has become a preferred alternative to institutional care. Yet mental-health provision within home care remains fragmented, reactive, and under-resourced. This doctoral research develops a comprehensive framework for integrating holistic mental-health strategies into elder home-care systems, addressing physical, psychological, social, digital, and policy dimensions.

Adopting a narrative-synthesis methodology, the study analysed 118 empirical and conceptual sources published between 2015 and 2025, including evidence on barriers to care, digital mental-health interventions, task-sharing models, and community-based wellness programmes. Findings indicate that older adults frequently face intersecting obstacles—economic hardship, geographical isolation, stigma, and inadequate insurance coverage—that restrict access to mental-health services. Workforce shortages, limited training, and fragmented governance further constrain quality and equity. Conversely, innovative models such as telehealth, hybrid digital-human interventions, and task-sharing programmes demonstrate potential to expand reach when supported by robust supervision and culturally sensitive implementation.

The research proposes the Holistic Integration Framework for Elder Home Care, grounded in four interdependent pillars:

  1. Access and Equity – ensuring affordability, inclusion, and infrastructure;
  2. Person-Centred Integration – aligning physical, psychological, and social care through co-production;
  3. Digital and Community Innovations – combining technology with human connection; and
  4. Sustainable Workforce and Policy – strengthening training, support, and inter-sectoral collaboration.

The thesis concludes that achieving mental-health equity in home care requires system-level transformation—linking health, social, and community sectors, investing in digital readiness, and valuing caregivers as essential partners. The framework contributes to theory by extending biopsychosocial and implementation models to include technological and policy determinants, and it provides actionable guidance for practitioners and policymakers committed to healthy ageing in place.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一个将整体心理健康策略整合到老年人居家护理系统中的综合框架，通过叙事综合方法分析118个文献源，提出了包含四个相互依存支柱的整体整合框架：可及性与公平、以人为本的整合、数字与社区创新、可持续劳动力与政策。
AI.research_question: 如何将整体心理健康策略整合到老年人居家护理系统中？
AI.motivation: 人口老龄化是全球重要趋势，居家护理成为首选替代机构护理的方式，但心理健康服务在居家护理中仍然分散、被动且资源不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生物心理社会模型和实施模型，扩展包含技术和政策决定因素。
AI.method: 叙事综合方法，分析2015-2025年间118个实证和概念文献源。
AI.findings: 老年人面临经济困难、地理隔离、污名化和保险覆盖不足等交叉障碍；劳动力短缺、培训有限和治理分散限制了质量和公平；远程医疗、混合数字-人类干预和任务共享项目等创新模式在适当支持下有扩展覆盖的潜力。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过纳入技术和政策决定因素，扩展了生物心理社会模型和实施模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实践者和政策制定者提供可操作的指导，支持"原地健康老龄化"；提出了包含四个支柱的整体整合框架，为系统级转型提供指导。

title: Elasticity for the Transmission of Interest Rates Movement between Central Banks and Consumer Banks
affiliations: National University of Singapore (NUS)

detail.title: Elasticity for the Transmission of Interest Rates Movement between Central Banks and Consumer Banks

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding was used in this work.

detail.abstract: Rise of central bank interest rate is always a subject of keen interest to news reporters as it is widely acknowledged to have a big impact on the broader economy, particularly in the saver interest rate and interest rates for car and home loans. But, is the transmission of the interest rate rise a one to one correspondence between the central bank and consumer bank? Or what is defined as here as the elasticity of interest rate transmission plotted as a correlation between movement of consumer interest rate and movement of central bank interest rate? My thinking is no. Specifically, whether the consumer bank also raises interest rate of an identical magnitude depends on its cash position as well as loan, deposit, and investment portfolio. If the consumer bank is flush with deposit and cash, then it may raise interest rate by a smaller magnitude. However, if the consumer bank is short of cash, it may raise interest rate by an identical magnitude to retain cash and attract deposits to reinforce the cash position of the bank. Hence, the efficiency in which a monetary policy decision is transmitted to the broader economy is varied and must be understood in the diversified context of the cash positions of different consumer banks serving the economy.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了央行利率上调向商业银行利率传导的弹性问题，发现传导效率并非一对一，而是取决于商业银行的现金头寸状况。
AI.research_question: 央行利率上调向商业银行利率传导的弹性是多少？这种传导是否是一对一的？
AI.motivation: 央行利率上调对经济有重要影响，但利率传导机制的具体效率尚未被充分理解，这对货币政策有效性至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 利率传导弹性理论、商业银行现金头寸管理理论、货币政策传导机制
AI.method: 理论分析框架，基于商业银行现金头寸、存贷款和投资组合状况的分析
AI.findings: 利率传导效率不是一对一的，取决于商业银行的现金头寸状况：现金充裕时传导幅度较小，现金短缺时传导幅度较大
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了利率传导弹性的概念，建立了基于商业银行现金头寸的利率传导理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解货币政策传导效率提供新视角，帮助商业银行更好地管理利率风险

title: The Effect of Political Capital on Migration Decisions in the Context of Climate Change in India
affiliations: University of Illinois, Urbana-Champaign

detail.title: The Effect of Political Capital on Migration Decisions in the Context of Climate Change in India
detail.abstract: Migration is a complex and dynamic process shaped by ecological and socioeconomic forces, now increasingly driven by climate stress. The World Bank projects up to 216 million internal climate migrants by 2050, displaced by droughts, failed crops, rising seas, and extreme weather. This study asks whether, in the face of climate stress, a rural household's connection to local political power shapes migration decisions, and how this influence evolves as stress intensifies. India provides an ideal setting for this inquiry: it faces acute heat stress and operates within an often clientelist political system. Using a stylized expected utility framework, the study predicts that the influence of political capital on migration follows an inverted Ushaped relationship with rising heat stress. Empirical analysis supports this pattern, showing that political capital has the strongest impact on migration in districts experiencing moderate climate stress. These findings have important policy implications, highlighting how existing local power structures shape who adapts to environmental change and how. Political capital can enable early, strategic migration, while those without access may face delayed, distress-driven movement, deepening social inequalities. Adaptation, therefore, is not only a response to climate risks, but also a reflection of unequal access to the political and institutional infrastructure that enables action.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了气候变化压力下农村家庭与地方政治权力的联系如何影响迁移决策。研究发现政治资本对迁移的影响与热应激呈倒U型关系，在中等气候压力地区影响最强。政治资本能促进早期战略性迁移，而无此资源者可能面临延迟的困境驱动迁移，加剧社会不平等。
AI.research_question: 面对气候压力，农村家庭与地方政治权力的联系如何影响迁移决策？这种影响如何随压力加剧而变化？
AI.motivation: 世界银行预测到2050年将有2.16亿内部气候移民，因干旱、作物歉收、海平面上升和极端天气而流离失所。印度面临严重热应激且存在庇护主义政治体系，为研究提供了理想环境。
AI.theoretical_framework: 采用简化的期望效用框架，预测政治资本对迁移的影响与热应激呈倒U型关系。
AI.method: 实证分析，检验政治资本在不同气候压力地区的迁移影响模式。
AI.findings: 政治资本对迁移的影响在经历中等气候压力的地区最强，支持倒U型关系的预测。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了适应气候变化不仅是应对气候风险，也反映了获取能够促成行动的政治和制度基础设施的不平等机会。
AI.practical_contributions: 强调现有地方权力结构如何塑造谁适应环境变化以及如何适应。政治资本能实现早期战略性迁移，而无此资源者可能面临延迟的困境驱动迁移，加深社会不平等。

title: A Broken Partnership: How Clothing Brands Exploit Suppliers and Harm Workers –And What Can Be Done About It
affiliations: New York University, Center for Business and Human Rights and New York University (NYU) - New York University

detail.title: A Broken Partnership: How Clothing Brands Exploit Suppliers and Harm Workers –And What Can Be Done About It
detail.abstract:
The global economic crisis caused by the Covid-19 pandemic hit apparel supply chains particularly hard. Beginning in spring 2020, Western clothing brands delayed or canceled orders from their suppliers in South and Southeast Asia, resulting in layoffs of hundreds of thousands of workers. 

Some brands refused to pay for clothes that were already made and, in some cases, for goods the brands had received. In Bangladesh—the world's second-largest apparel exporter after China—factory owners warned that they could face insolvency, forestalling the rehiring of furloughed employees, most of whom are poor women from rural parts of the country. 

Economic conditions began to ease in 2021, and major clothing brands and retailers, whom we refer to collectively as “buyers,” rescinded some of their harshest measures. But some practices unfavorable to suppliers in Bangladesh and elsewhere persisted, often in subtler forms. These have included:

Pressuring suppliers for unreasonable price reductions: Buyers have pushed for excessive discounts after order prices are confirmed or production has commenced. They have abused “open costing” methods, which require that supplier’s share a detailed cost accounting of their production process with buyers, and have encouraged such extreme competition among suppliers that some factory owners have accepted offers which have resulted in losses. 

Delaying delivery and withholding payment: Buyers have demanded that suppliers hold orders beyond planned shipping dates while with holding payment for finished goods. Meanwhile, payment timelines for shipped goods have been extended to 90 days and in some instances, to as long as six months, leading indirectly to reduced worker wages. Pre-pandemic payment timelines ranged from 30 to 60 days.

AI.tldr: 新冠疫情对服装供应链造成严重冲击，西方品牌取消订单、延迟付款，导致亚洲供应商面临破产风险，工人失业。2021年情况有所缓解，但买方仍通过压价、延迟付款等不公平做法损害供应商利益。
AI.research_question: 新冠疫情下西方服装品牌如何通过不公平商业行为影响亚洲供应商的生存和工人权益？
AI.motivation: 揭示新冠疫情背景下全球服装供应链中买方权力的滥用现象，特别是对孟加拉国等亚洲供应商的不公平待遇及其社会影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 全球价值链理论、买方-供应商权力不对称、供应链风险管理
AI.method: 案例分析法，聚焦孟加拉国服装出口行业在疫情中的具体遭遇
AI.findings: 1) 品牌取消已生产订单并拒付货款；2) 要求不合理降价，滥用成本透明机制；3) 延迟交货和延长付款周期至90-180天；4) 间接导致工人工资下降和失业问题
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了全球价值链中权力不对称理论在危机情境下的应用，揭示了供应链风险向弱势群体转移的机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供改善供应链公平性的依据，为供应商提供应对买方权力滥用的策略参考，促进供应链可持续发展

title: ESG Mania and Institutional Investments
affiliations: Southern Illinois University Edwardsville - Department of Economics & Finance and University of Edinburgh Business School

detail.title: ESG Mania and Institutional Investments
detail.abstract: We investigate the motivations and consequences of the explosively increased institutional demand for ESG securities in recent decades. The literature suggests two competing explanations, namely impact-chasing vs impact-washing. We do not find consistent evidence that institutions are sincerely impact-chasing. Instead, we find consistent evidence that institutional ESG investments are mainly driven by fad, reputation concern and fund flow, suggesting that institutions are more likely impact-washing. Institutions herding into the ESG market is common regardless of stock and institution size, firms' ESG rating, whether institutions are informed, or market conditions; small or ill-performing institutions exhibit stronger herding intensity than their counterparts. Institutional ESG herding neither drives up firms' ESG engagement nor reduces cost of capital. Herding institutions do not outperform their peers but attract more temporary fund flows. A panel regression analysis suggests that reputational concern and attracting fund flow are the essential motivations.

title: The Wages of Adversity Boosting: A Theory of Law, Inequality, and the Stories We Tell
affiliations: University of California, Davis - School of Law

detail.title: The Wages of Adversity Boosting: A Theory of Law, Inequality, and the Stories We Tell

declarations.ethicsApproval: This research involved human participants and was approved by the University of California, Davis IRB Protocol ID #’s 2086760-1 and 2130801-1.

publicationDetails.detailsText: 99 S. Cal. L. Rev. __ (forthcoming 2026)

detail.abstract:
The ground-shaking enactment of President Donald Trump's "Big Beautiful Bill" is just the latest instantiation of an enduring puzzle: Why are Americans, rich and poor alike, so averse to the redistribution of wealth and opportunity to the least fortunate among us? The puzzle is as difficult as it is important. Standard answers range from the woefully incomplete (e.g., politics) to the surprisingly inaccurate (e.g., ignorance).

This Article offers empirical support for a different hypothesis: There is something wrong with the stories we tell when we talk about ourselves. Everywhere Americans turn, prominent figures regale us with stories of how they've overcome great adversity through heroic levels of skill and determination. From Donald Trump to Drake, and Steph Curry to Elon Musk, successful people somehow seem to share a remarkable life story in which, by their own telling, they achieved immense success in the face of dire challenges through grit and hard work alone. Lost in these narratives, however, is an important truth. At some point along their glidepaths to success, each of these figures also benefitted from significant privilege.

I call this story-telling phenomenon "adversity boosting." And after describing its motivations and its prevalence, I present the results of two original experiments that test its impact. My findings suggest that an individual's exposure to adversity boosting rhetoric significantly reduces their support for laws that would promote a level economic playing field.

After presenting this evidence, the Article grapples with its implications. Put simply, the stories we tell about adversity and the supposedly singular power of perseverance matter. They matter because when public figures bombard us with adversity-boosting tales and downplay the role that privilege played in their success, ordinary Americans may come to believe that the government need not do much to ensure equality of opportunity. Adversity boosting, in other words, is not a harmless act of self-promotion. It is a pervasive practice that may partially explain America's exceptional appetite for societal inequality.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实证研究发现，美国社会中普遍存在的"逆境夸大"叙事现象会显著降低人们对促进经济公平政策的支持度。成功人士在讲述自身成功故事时夸大逆境、忽视特权作用，这种叙事方式可能部分解释了美国社会对不平等的容忍度。

AI.motivation: 特朗普"美丽大法案"等政策反映了美国人对财富再分配的普遍抵触，传统解释（如政治、无知）不够充分，需要探索更深层的社会心理机制。

AI.theory_contributions: 提出"逆境夸大"概念，揭示成功叙事如何塑造公众对机会平等的认知，为理解美国社会不平等容忍度提供新的理论视角。

title: The Role of Leadership in Navigating Cultural Differences in the Workplace: An Empirical Study

detail.title: The Role of Leadership in Navigating Cultural Differences in the Workplace: An Empirical Study
detail.abstract: This research investigates which specific leadership behaviors and attributes form effective team relationships in multiculturally staffed workplaces. Through qualitative content analysis of 15 manager-employee interviews from multiculturally staffed teams complemented by quantitative frequency analysis of thematic coding, this research determines key success factors. The findings report that the leader's personal characteristics-i.e., empathy, inclusiveness, and active problemsolving-are the most crucial elements, appearing as the most frequent theme in the results. The study also confirms the powerful impacts of communication behaviors and conflict resolution. The present research extends the literature by providing empirical evidence to connect the current theoretical frameworks with the reality of the individuals in the global workplace.

detail.abstract: This paper explores the theoretical, empirical, and computational dimensions of economic dynamics and control theory. It examines dynamic optimization, differential equations, and control theory as fundamental tools for analyzing economic systems over time. Furthermore, the study emphasizes the role of computational methods such as artificial intelligence, genetic algorithms, neural networks, parallel computing, and fuzzy logic in extending the applicability of classical models. Decision support systems and databases are evaluated as vital components of modern policy-making processes. Empirical applications are presented in financial crisis simulations, portfolio optimization, cryptocurrency markets, and sustainable development. The findings suggest that integrating computational methods with classical economic theory provides more robust tools for analysis, forecasting, and policy design. The study contributes to the literature by filling existing methodological gaps and proposing an interdisciplinary roadmap for future research in economics and finance.

title: Trade Policy Uncertainty and the Diversification of Export Destinations
affiliations: Kellogg School of Management and

detail.title: Trade Policy Uncertainty and the Diversification of Export Destinations
detail.abstract: Firms exporting to the U.S. are experiencing the highest levels of trade policy uncertainty in recent history. This paper examines how firms in Mexico, a leading source of U.S. imports, responded to the uncertainty following the 2016 U.S. presidential election. Comparing manufacturing firms that primarily exported to the U.S. (U.S.-oriented) with those exporting to Europe prior to the election, we find no effect on production or exports. However, U.S.oriented firms reduced the share of exports to the U.S. by six percentage points, reallocating exports to Europe, highlighting adjustments in destination portfolios diversification rather than aggregate export volumes.

affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Critical Points of Primality Collapse in Linear Forms (n+1) vs (2n+1)
detail.abstract: We investigate the phenomenon of primality collapse in the paired linear forms f 1 (n)=n+1 f 2 (n)=2n+ 1 Starting from values of (n) where both forms are prime, we observe that this property fails unpredictably as (n) increases. We define and measure critical points-values of (n) where both forms are composite-and analyse their distribution using sieve theory and probabilistic heuristics. The results have implications for number theory, cryptographic key generation, and the statistical study of prime distribution, with potential connections to the Riemann Hypothesis.

detail.title: Quantum Image Edge Detection

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors would like to thank Mr. Manuel Rudolph for his valuable insights and guidance throughout this research as a mentor. We also acknowledge the support of the BeyondQuantum team (part of ThinkingBeyond) and Dr. Filip Bar who provided us access to the prerequisite courses, computational resources and a platform to conduct this research.

detail.abstract: Edge detection is a core part of image processing. It is crucial for object recognition, segmentation, and computer vision tasks. Modern day classical methods like Sobel, Canny, and Laplacian operators have been widely used, but they face limitations in scalability, noise sensitivity, and computational efficiency for high-resolution data. This study explores a quantum image processing (QIP) approach to edge detection, which uses quantum parallelism and amplitude encoding to process image data in a quantum circuit framework. We implemented the Quantum Hadamard Edge Detection (QHED) algorithm using the Quantum Probability Image Encoding (QPIE) model and simulated it on IBM Qiskit. Results show that, while current quantum hardware does not yield the best resolution, the quantum method achieved edge detection results comparable to classical methods, with theoretical advantages in speedup and resource compression for large-scale images. Using the findings, this paper critically analyzes the theoretical potential of QIP for scalable image analysis and its practical disadvantages compared to the classical approach.

AI.tldr: 本文探索了量子图像处理在边缘检测中的应用，通过量子并行性和振幅编码在量子电路框架中处理图像数据。使用QHED算法和QPIE模型在IBM Qiskit上模拟，结果显示量子方法在边缘检测效果上与经典方法相当，对大规模图像具有理论上的加速和资源压缩优势，但当前量子硬件分辨率有限。

detail.abstract: We study relationships in which the agent is uncertain about which actions, if any, are productive for the principal. In each period of experimentation, the agent finds a productive action with some probability; this sequence of probabilities defines "clarity". Our model predicts a reversal in termination rates: agents with higher clarity are less likely to end relationships in the early search phase, but more likely to end them later, since they find productive relationships easier to replace. Using transaction-level data from Ethiopia's rose industry, we document that clarity problems are economically significant. Moreover, exporters that are more likely to form productive relationships, those with higher clarity, are also more likely to terminate them when outside options improve. This explains why domestically owned exporters, despite lower discount factors, are less responsive to positive shocks to the outside option than foreign-owned exporters. Clarity emerges as a key determinant of relationship dynamics.

title: Structural Causal Modeling using DAGs (Tutorial Note)
affiliations: Center for Creative Foresight

detail.title: Structural Causal Modeling using DAGs (Tutorial Note)
detail.abstract: This tutorial note provides an overview of Structural Causal Modeling (SCM) using Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAGs), based on the seminal work of Judea Pearl. Originating in path analysis pioneered by American geneticist Sewall Wright, SCM is a graph-theoretic approach to structural equation modeling. This method represents causal assumptions through the presence or absence of directed arrows between variables, with DAGs offering a principled approach to identifying minimal covariate sets to control for confounding. Key advantages of SCM using DAGs include testable implications, identification of conditioning variables, and addressing confounding bias through implied instrumental variables.

detail.abstract: While times change, the issue of Mandatory minimum sentencing in law which sounds simple but is actually multifaceted when you start thinking about it. Which in simpler terms means that the law says you have to give at least a certain minimum punishment for a particular crime, irrespective of mitigating circumstances. This idea started mainly to make sure that people who do serious crimes get punished properly. However, many people argue that it can sometimes lead to injustice because every case is different. This paper will examine what mandatory minimum sentencing is, why it was introduced, and whether it is really fair or not.

title: Strategic Safety Time-Lags: AGI-Driven CPA Reversal in U.S. Missile Defense, 2027-2032 -Part I
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Strategic Safety Time-Lags: AGI-Driven CPA Reversal in U.S. Missile Defense, 2027-2032 -Part I
detail.abstract:
The prospect of embedding advanced AI-and, prospectively, AGI-into the U.S. missile-defense kill chain is not a marginal upgrade but a structural lever that can invert the long-standing Cost-Probability Asymmetry (CPA). Historically, cheap salvos and decoys imposed costly redundancy on defenders. If an AI/AGI layer materially improves target discrimination, decision latency, and global fire-allocation, the expected cost per successful intercept falls while the attacker's cost per successful penetration rises-a CPA reversal. The resulting interval of advantage is the strategic safety time-window; it directly constitutes a strategic safety time-lag relative to peers whose architectures cannot achieve the same reversal. This paper makes two linked claims. First, the United States is already operationalizing AI across the Sense-Decide-Act stack-linking space/terrestrial sensors, LLM/agent decision support, and integrated C2-to-effector allocation-so that a CPA reversal is testable at scale (DoD Task Force Lima, 2024). Second, under AGI accelerationism, states compress deployment when algorithmic tempo yields durable, asymmetric gains. The testable forecast for 2027-2032: a sustained reduction in intercept rounds per target and duplicate engagements, alongside delays in peer remedial deployments. I then formalize the CPA model, map the stack, and specify falsifiable indicators. Quick, checkable anchors

DoD‘s Task Force Lima established governance/on-ramps for GenAI/LLMs (DoDTask Force Lima, 2024). GIDE/JADC2 exercises explicitly test AI-enabled data fusion and decision acceleration ( DefenseScoop, 2024). . Project Convergence (Capstone) demonstrates joint sensor-to-shooter loops suitable for AI-driven interception logic (U.S. Army, 2025) . NGI is slated for initial fielding in the late-2020s, providing the kinetic tier an AI C2stack exploits (GAO, 2024).

AI.motivation: 传统导弹防御面临成本-概率不对称性挑战，即防御方需要付出高昂成本应对攻击方的廉价导弹和诱饵，而AI/AGI技术有望从根本上改变这一格局。
AI.theoretical_framework: 成本-概率不对称性(CPA)理论、战略安全时间窗口理论、AGI加速主义理论
AI.method: 理论建模、技术架构分析、实证案例研究（DoD Task Force Lima、GIDE/JADC2演习、Project Convergence等）
AI.findings: 美国已在导弹防御的感知-决策-行动全链条中部署AI技术，AI/AGI能够显著降低每次成功拦截的预期成本，同时提高攻击方每次成功穿透的成本，实现CPA逆转。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了CPA逆转的理论框架，定义了战略安全时间窗口概念，为AI/AGI在军事领域的战略影响提供了理论分析工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为美国导弹防御系统提供了AI/AGI集成的具体路径，预测了2027-2032年间拦截效率和作战效能的提升，并为政策制定提供了可验证的指标。

title: The "Conventional" Hypothesis: Deficit Estimates, Savings Rates, Twin Deficits and Yield Curves
affiliations: Cato Institute

detail.title: The "Conventional" Hypothesis: Deficit Estimates, Savings Rates, Twin Deficits and Yield Curves
detail.abstract:
At a January 2004 meeting of the American Economic Association, Peter Orszag, Robert Rubin and Alan Sinai offered four hypotheses. The four were purported to predict the effects of estimated future budget deficits on yield curves, real interest rates, the national savings rate, the current account deficit, the dollar exchange rate and investor confidence. They called these four hypotheses “the conventional view.” 

Several of these conventional hypotheses depend on an implausible chain of causality, such as requiring that deficits cause inflation to fall to raise the real interest rates or requiring that deficits cause short-term interest rates to fall to steepen the yield curve. Some of the four are inconsistent with each other, and with previous versions of this whole exercise in conventionality. Ardent “twin deficits” theorists such as Larry Summers, for example, used to postulate that deficits made the dollar rise —not fall. All four hypotheses are completely inconsistent with all direct evidence from U.S. time series (bond yields have not been correlated with any measure of national budget deficits) and are also contradicted by international comparisons (e.g., Japan’s huge budget deficits were accompanied by exceptionally low interest rates and inflation, and a trade surplus).

Reynolds finds no evidence that either actual or projected budget deficits (at home or abroad) raise real or nominal interest rates, steepen the yield curve, reduce national savings, cause “twin deficits,” or make the dollar go down or up. The logic behind such conventional speculations is flawed and contradictory. The evidence is nonexistent.

AI.tldr: 该论文批判了2004年美国经济协会会议上提出的关于预算赤字影响的四个传统假设，指出这些假设在逻辑上存在缺陷且相互矛盾，并且缺乏实证支持。
AI.research_question: 预算赤字是否真的会影响收益率曲线、实际利率、国民储蓄率、经常账户赤字、美元汇率和投资者信心？
AI.motivation: 挑战经济学界关于预算赤字影响的传统观点，这些观点缺乏实证支持且逻辑上存在矛盾。
AI.theoretical_framework: 批判传统经济学理论中关于预算赤字与宏观经济变量关系的假设，特别是"双赤字"理论。
AI.method: 通过分析美国时间序列数据和国际比较（如日本案例）来检验传统假设的有效性。
AI.findings: 没有发现预算赤字与实际或名义利率、收益率曲线、国民储蓄、"双赤字"或美元汇率之间存在任何关联的证据。
AI.theory_contributions: 质疑并反驳了关于预算赤字影响的传统经济学理论，揭示了这些理论的逻辑缺陷和内部矛盾。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了基于实证的视角，避免基于有缺陷的传统假设做出经济决策。

title: When Does Regulation by Insurance Work? The Case of Frontier AI

detail.title: When Does Regulation by Insurance Work? The Case of Frontier AI

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I am consulting for the AI Underwriting Company. However, this research was conducted prior to this consulting work and was not financially supported by the AI Underwriting Company.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was supported by the Centre for the Governance of AI and the Cambridge Boston Alignment Initiative.

detail.abstract: No one doubts the utility of insurance for its ability to spread risk or streamline claims management; much debated is when and how insurance uptake can improve welfare by reducing harm, despite moral hazard. Proponents and dissenters of "regulation by insurance" have now documented a number of cases of insurers succeeding or failing to have such a net regulatory effect (in contrast with a net hazard effect). Collecting these examples together and drawing on an extensive economics literature, this Article develops a principled framework for evaluating insurance uptake's effect in a given context. The presence of certain distortions – including judgment-proofness, competitive dynamics, and behavioral biases – creates potential for a net regulatory effect. How much of that potential gets realized then depends on the type of policyholder, type of risk, type of insurer, and the structure of the insurance market. The analysis suggests regulation by insurance can be particularly effective for catastrophic non-product accidents where market mechanisms provide insufficient discipline and psychological biases are strongest. As a demonstration, the framework is applied to the frontier AI industry, revealing significant potential for a net regulatory effect but also the need for policy intervention to realize that potential. One option is a carefully designed mandate that encourages forming a specialized insurer or mutual, focuses on catastrophic rather than routine risks, and bars pure captives.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个评估保险吸收对风险减少影响的框架，指出在某些扭曲条件下保险可能产生净监管效应而非净风险效应，并以AI行业为例展示了该框架的应用。
AI.research_question: 保险吸收何时以及如何能够通过减少损害来改善福利，尽管存在道德风险？
AI.motivation: 关于"保险监管"的效用存在争议，需要建立一个原则性框架来评估保险吸收在特定情境下的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于经济学文献，识别了导致净监管效应潜力的关键扭曲因素：判决无力、竞争动态和行为偏见。
AI.method: 收集现有案例研究，结合广泛的经济学文献分析，开发评估框架并应用于前沿AI行业。
AI.findings: 保险监管在灾难性非产品事故中特别有效，这些情况下市场机制提供不足的约束且心理偏见最强。
AI.theory_contributions: 开发了一个系统框架来评估保险吸收的净监管效应潜力及其实现条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了评估保险监管有效性的工具，并提出了针对AI行业的具体政策建议，包括精心设计的强制保险要求。
