title: Deregulating Job Protection: Evidence on Productivity and Income Distribution from Italy
affiliations: Asian Development Bank and Centro Studi Confindustria

detail.title: Deregulating Job Protection: Evidence on Productivity and Income Distribution from Italy

publicationDetails.detailsText: ADB Economics Working Paper Series No. 809

detail.abstract: This paper investigates the impact of job protection deregulation on firms’ productivity, leveraging a size-based cutoff in the eligibility criteria of a pivotal 2014 labor market reform in Italy. The reform replaced reinstatement requirements with a progressive compensation system for unjust dismissals of new hires in firms with more than 15 employees, while leaving smaller firms unaffected. We find that total factor productivity increased by 1% in treated firms relative to control firms, on average, in each of the 5 years following the reform’s implementation. Labor productivity gains were slightly larger, also driven by capital deepening. Next, we extend the analysis to uncover how the productivity gains were distributed between employers and workers. Capital owners benefited more, as the reform led to a gradual decline in the labor share of value added, reaching 0.7 percentage points after 5 years.

AI.tldr: 本文利用意大利2014年劳动市场改革中基于企业规模的资格标准，研究了就业保护放松管制对企业生产率的影响。研究发现，改革后受处理企业的全要素生产率平均每年增长1%，劳动生产率增长更大，资本所有者获益更多。
AI.research_question: 就业保护放松管制如何影响企业生产率？这些生产率收益如何在雇主和工人之间分配？
AI.motivation: 研究就业保护法规改革对企业绩效的影响，特别是了解生产率收益的分配情况。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于劳动市场规制理论，特别是就业保护法规对企业行为和生产率的影响机制。
AI.method: 利用意大利2014年劳动市场改革中基于企业规模（15名员工）的资格标准作为准自然实验，采用断点回归设计。
AI.findings: 1. 受处理企业的全要素生产率在改革后5年内平均每年增长1%；2. 劳动生产率增长更大，部分由资本深化驱动；3. 资本所有者获益更多，劳动力在增加值中的份额在5年后下降0.7个百分点。
AI.theory_contributions: 为就业保护法规对企业生产率的影响提供了因果证据，揭示了生产率收益在资本和劳动之间的分配模式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供关于劳动市场改革效果的实证依据，有助于理解放松就业保护对企业和工人的实际影响。

title: A Contingent Behavior Approach For Estimating Price Elasticities
affiliations: University of California, San Diego (UCSD) - Department of Economics, Zhejiang University, Göteborg University - Department of Economics and University of North Carolina (UNC) at Chapel Hill - Department of Environmental Sciences and Engineering

detail.title: A Contingent Behavior Approach For Estimating Price Elasticities

publicationDetails.detailsText: ENEECO-D-25-03000

detail.abstract: Abstract ​Analysis of many policy interventions depends on the availability of accurate estimates of price, income and other elasticities. Economists typically use revealed preference data to estimate these elasticities ex-post. We propose a simple survey-based contingent behavior  approach for estimating ex-ante (expected) elasticities as well as their distributions in the population. Ex-ante and ex-post estimates of eleasticities may differ for legitimate reasons; both are   relevant to policymakers. We illustrate this CB approach using data from seven Global South countries. Results show that it is possible to develop contemporaneous country-specific estimates of ex-ante elasticities quickly and inexpensively in data-poor environments. We also discuss how these ex-ante elasticities may inform policy acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于调查的或有行为方法，用于在数据匮乏环境中快速、低成本地估计事前（预期）弹性及其在人群中的分布。通过七个全球南方国家的数据验证了该方法的可行性。
AI.research_question: 如何在数据匮乏环境中快速、低成本地估计事前弹性及其分布？
AI.motivation: 政策干预分析需要准确的价格、收入等弹性估计，但经济学家通常使用事后显示偏好数据。事前和事后弹性估计可能因合理原因存在差异，两者对政策制定者都相关。
AI.theoretical_framework: 或有行为方法、事前弹性估计理论、显示偏好理论
AI.method: 基于调查的或有行为方法，使用七个全球南方国家的数据进行实证验证
AI.findings: 在数据匮乏环境中，可以快速、低成本地开发同时期的国别事前弹性估计
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于调查的事前弹性估计方法，补充了传统显示偏好方法
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了在数据稀缺环境下获取弹性估计的实用工具，有助于政策接受度的评估

title: Endogenous Environmental R&D Networks and Tax Credibility
affiliations: Chonnam National University, Chonnam National University and Chulalongkorn University

detail.title: Endogenous Environmental R&D Networks and Tax Credibility

publicationDetails.detailsText: ENEECO-D-25-02964

detail.abstract: This paper considers the endogenous formation of environmental R&D (ER&D) networks and examines the effects of carbon taxation under alternative regulatory timings: the commitment and non-commitment regimes. Under the commitment regime, the tax is set ex ante and is treated as credible, which induces coordinated ER&D investment and sustains the complete network as a stable and welfare-enhancing structure. Under the non-commitment regime, however, the flexibility in tax adjustment may weaken coordination, which results in a stable network structure that might not be socially desirable unless ER&D efficiency is low. Finally, comparisons between the stable networks under the alternative regulatory timings show that the commitment (non-commitment) regime yields higher welfare when ER&D efficiency is high (low). Our findings suggest useful policy implications for the efficient design of the carbon tax mechanism under the endogenous formation of ER&D organization, highlighting the need for supplementary measures to ensure socially desirable outcomes with stable network formation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了环境研发网络的内生形成，比较了承诺和非承诺两种碳税监管时机的影响。承诺制度下碳税事前设定，促进协调研发投资，维持完全网络结构；非承诺制度下税收灵活性可能削弱协调，导致次优网络结构。研究发现承诺制度在研发效率高时福利更高，非承诺制度在研发效率低时更优。
AI.research_question: 碳税在不同监管时机（承诺与非承诺制度）下如何影响环境研发网络的内生形成及其福利效应？
AI.motivation: 理解碳税政策设计如何影响企业间环境研发合作网络的形成，以及不同监管时机对协调效率和福利结果的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 网络形成理论、环境研发合作理论、碳税政策设计理论
AI.method: 理论模型分析，比较承诺制度和非承诺制度下环境研发网络的内生形成机制
AI.findings: 1. 承诺制度促进协调研发投资，维持完全网络结构；2. 非承诺制度可能削弱协调，导致次优网络结构；3. 承诺制度在研发效率高时福利更高，非承诺制度在研发效率低时更优
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了环境研发网络内生形成的理论框架；2. 揭示了监管时机对网络稳定性和福利的影响机制；3. 拓展了碳税政策设计的理论边界
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为碳税机制设计提供政策启示；2. 强调需要补充措施确保社会期望结果；3. 指导政策制定者根据研发效率选择合适监管时机

title: Active or passive: Deposit investments of individual investors
affiliations: Copenhagen Business School, Copenhagen Business School, Copenhagen Business School and Copenhagen Business School

detail.title: Active or passive: Deposit investments of individual investors
detail.abstract: Using detailed register-based data with information on individuals’ deposit holdings, we test whether individuals are active investors when it comes to their deposit holdings and why they hold deposits. We provide three main findings. First, we show that deposit investors are active, as they actively reduce their deposit holdings following an exogenous increase captured by unexpected inheritances. Second, following large exogeneous deposit inflows, people reallocate away from low-return deposits to higher expected-return assets, such as bonds and stocks, in line with classical deposit-demand theories. Third, people use deposits and voluntary unemployment insurance as substitutes, meaning deposits are used to insure against sudden negative income shocks.

AI.tldr: 基于详细注册数据的研究发现，个人在存款投资方面是活跃的投资者，会主动调整存款配置，并将存款与失业保险作为替代品来应对收入冲击。
AI.research_question: 个人是否是活跃的存款投资者？为什么人们持有存款？
AI.motivation: 理解个人在存款投资方面的行为模式及其持有存款的动机。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经典存款需求理论，存款作为保险工具的理论。
AI.method: 使用详细的注册数据，分析个人存款持有情况，特别是对外生冲击（如意外继承）的反应。
AI.findings: 1. 存款投资者是活跃的，会主动减少存款持有；2. 人们会将存款重新配置到更高预期回报的资产；3. 存款与自愿失业保险互为替代品。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了经典存款需求理论，并扩展了存款作为保险工具的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为个人理财和金融机构的产品设计提供了实证依据。

title: Underserved and Low-Competition Business Sectors in Pakistan
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Underserved and Low-Competition Business Sectors in Pakistan

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author, Ameer Hamza, declares that there are no financial, commercial, or personal relationships that could be construed as a potential conflict of interest in relation to the research presented in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research did not involve human participants, patients, or case studies requiring ethical approval.
declarations.funderStatement: N/A.

detail.abstract: This paper examines low-competition and underserved industries in Pakistan, with a focus on technology, e-commerce, EdTech, Health-Tech, and Agri-Tech. It highlights key gaps in digital skills, innovation, and entrepreneurship while outlining opportunities for growth. The study suggests that targeted investments and skill development can position Pakistan as a regional leader in digital transformation.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了巴基斯坦低竞争和未充分服务行业（技术、电子商务、教育科技、健康科技和农业科技）的现状，识别了数字技能、创新和创业方面的关键差距，并提出了通过针对性投资和技能发展使巴基斯坦成为区域数字转型领导者的机会。
AI.research_question: 巴基斯坦在技术、电子商务、教育科技、健康科技和农业科技等低竞争和未充分服务行业面临的主要挑战和机遇是什么？
AI.motivation: 巴基斯坦在这些新兴技术领域存在巨大的发展潜力，但面临着数字技能不足、创新能力薄弱和创业生态不完善等挑战，需要通过系统研究来识别关键问题并制定发展策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于数字转型理论、产业发展理论和技能差距分析框架，结合新兴市场技术采纳模型。
AI.method: 行业分析研究方法，通过文献综述、现状评估和机会识别来分析巴基斯坦特定技术行业的发展状况。
AI.findings: 巴基斯坦在技术、电子商务、教育科技、健康科技和农业科技等领域存在显著的数字技能差距、创新不足和创业支持体系不完善等问题，但同时也具备成为区域数字转型领导者的巨大潜力。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了新兴市场数字转型理论，特别是在巴基斯坦特定行业背景下的应用，为类似发展中国家的技术产业发展提供了理论参考。
AI.practical_contributions: 为巴基斯坦政府、投资者和创业者提供了具体的发展建议，包括针对性投资方向、技能培训重点和产业发展策略，有助于推动巴基斯坦成为区域数字转型的领导者。

title: Not Just a Transition
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Göteborg University - Department of Economics, affiliation not provided to SSRN and University of the Witwatersrand

detail.title: Not Just a Transition

publicationDetails.detailsText: ENEECO-D-25-03019

detail.abstract: To meet the targets of the Paris Agreement, coal must be phased out urgently across the world. To support low- and middle-income countries in phasing out coal, various countries, including South Africa, have signed Just Energy Transition Partnerships (JETPs) with a group of developed countries, including the US, the UK, Germany and others. Yet, little is known about the effectiveness of JETPs in phasing down coal investments. This paper examines the stock price reaction of South African coal mining companies to the announcement of the South African JETP at COP26. Our findings indicate a significant decline in coal company valuations, suggesting that investors perceive the JETP as a credible threat to coal profitability and are factoring in the risk of stranded assets. These results are further supported by evidence from international coal markets, where futures prices also exhibited large and statistically significant declines.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析南非煤炭公司在COP26宣布JETP后的股价反应，发现煤炭公司估值显著下降，表明投资者将JETP视为对煤炭盈利能力的可信威胁，并考虑到了搁浅资产风险。
AI.research_question: JETPs在逐步减少煤炭投资方面的有效性如何？
AI.motivation: 为实现《巴黎协定》目标，全球需紧急淘汰煤炭。为支持中低收入国家淘汰煤炭，包括南非在内的多个国家与发达国家签署了JETPs，但JETPs在减少煤炭投资方面的有效性尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于投资者对政策风险的感知和搁浅资产风险理论
AI.method: 分析南非煤炭矿业公司在COP26宣布南非JETP后的股价反应，并结合国际煤炭市场的期货价格数据
AI.findings: 煤炭公司估值显著下降，国际煤炭期货价格也出现大幅且统计显著的下跌
AI.theory_contributions: 为JETPs政策有效性提供了实证证据，支持了投资者对政策风险感知影响资产估值的理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了JETPs有效性的直接证据，有助于评估类似气候政策的实施效果
